title: Senior Full Stack Java - React Developer
description:
Senior Full Stack Java - React Developer

Brazil

Senior Software Engineer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary


As a Senior Full Stack Java - React Developer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining high-quality software solutions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable and efficient software applications. Your role will involve leading technical projects, mentoring junior engineers, and continuously improving software development practices to ensure the delivery of robust and reliable software systems.


Responsibilities and Duties


  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable full-stack applications using React, TypeScript, Java, and Spring Boot across frontend and backend layers;
  • Architect and implement robust RESTful APIs, real-time data integrations, and high-performance backend services with proper caching and optimization strategies;
  • Build modern, responsive, and highly interactive user interfaces, integrating streaming data, advanced search, and filtering capabilities;
  • Contribute to system design decisions, code reviews, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native deployments while ensuring high engineering standards and best practices.


Essential Skills


  • Experience with strong full-stack expertise in both frontend and backend;
  • Advanced proficiency in React, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript (ES6+), including strong CSS skills (Flexbox, Grid, responsive design);
  • Experience with UI frameworks such as MUI, Tailwind, or Ant Design, and solid frontend testing experience;
  • Strong expertise in Java and Spring Boot, designing and building scalable, secure RESTful APIs;
  • Experience with relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Redis);
  • Strong understanding of system design principles, caching mechanisms, and performance optimization in distributed systems;
  • Experience integrating REST APIs and real-time or streaming data solutions;
  • Hands-on experience with message brokers such as Kafka and search technologies like Elasticsearch;
  • Experience working with Kubernetes and cloud platforms (AWS preferred; GCP, Azure, or OCI acceptable);
  • Strong knowledge of Git and GitHub workflows (branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews) and CI/CD pipelines including GitHub Actions.



About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: EDI Integration Developer
description:

  • Team player who acts – not just discusses

title: Lead Test Engineer
description:
Who are we?

Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Europe - Romania, Poland, and Ukraine, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.


Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past three years and plans to continue growing.


Key responsibilities

  • Demonstrate a deep, system-level understanding of the entire product architecture to ensure comprehensive and thorough testing across all layers.
  • Proactively identify, coordinate, and manage cross-team dependencies to ensure seamless end-to-end quality and delivery.
  • Employ extensive testing experience across Native Mobile Applications, Backend services, and Front-end systems .
  • Design and execute advanced testing techniques, including thorough Monkey Testing , and champion the introduction of Chaos Engineering practices into the development pipeline.
  • Identify tasks/dependencies/risks during backlog grooming/planning.
  • Provide reasonable test estimates and feedback on priorities.
  • Fully understand and actively provide ways to improve project/solution level test strategy/test design principles.
  • Contribute to the evaluation of testing tools/techniques/strategies.
  • Contribute effectively to the development of a project's test strategy and automation suite.
  • Collaborate with developers/business analysts for feedback into software design and tests.
  • Assist with effective test reporting and contribute to ensuring the CI/CD pipeline has thorough test coverages.
  • Contribute effectively to utilize an automation framework for testing and the creation of test scripts (different automation test layers such as UI or API Acceptance Tests).
  • Identify gaps in the current automation suite and help prioritize those / get them into the backlog.
  • Investigate and assist in diagnosing issues.
  • Share testing/product knowledge with other team members.

Must have

  • 5+ years of professional experience in Quality Assurance or Software Testing, with a focus on large, complex, and distributed systems.
  • Proven experience as a coordinator or leader managing QA activities across multiple, interdependent teams and technical domains (Mobile, Web, Backend).
  • Deep expertise in various testing methodologies, including mandatory experience with Monkey Testing and/or a strong theoretical or practical background in Chaos Engineering/Resilience Testing.
  • Mandatory professional experience testing: Native Mobile Applications (iOS and/or Android), Distributed Backend/Microservices Platforms.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms, preferably AWS, and understanding of how cloud services (e.g., EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS) impact system testing.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

  • Professional experience in complex frontend web applications.
  • Automation is a plus; experience programming or scripting in at least one modern language (e.g., Python or Ruby).


What we offer

  • 100% remote in Poland, Romania, Ukraine, or Brazil.
  • B2B Contract.
  • English classes.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de um Data Engineer para compor o time! Somos uma startup jurídica que busca constantemente soluções para facilitar a vida dos advogados e advogadas do Brasil. Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.


Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar. Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco!


Responsabilidades:

  • Criar análises e relatórios a partir de diferentes fontes de dados, com foco em gerar insights acionáveis.
  • Construir e manter modelos de dados eficientes (camadas analíticas, camada semantica, views, data marts).
  • Trabalhar com ferramentas como DBT, SQL, Python e ambientes como BigQuery ou Redshift.
  • Criar e documentar transformações de dados com boas práticas de versionamento e testes.
  • Colaborar com engenheiros de dados, analistas e product managers para garantir dados confiáveis.
  • Desenvolver dashboards (ex: Metabase, Looker) para visualização de métricas e KPIs.
  • Apoiar a criação de pequenos modelos preditivos ou análises estatísticas simples quando necessário.


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida com SQL e modelagem de dados.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de transformação de dados como DBT ou equivalente.
  • Capacidade de realizar análises exploratórias e criar relatórios com storytelling.
  • Noções de Python para análises e automações básicas.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de visualização de dados.
  • Mentalidade orientada a produto e negócio: entender o \"porquê\" por trás dos dados.
  • Conhecimento de boas práticas de versionamento e qualidade de dados.


Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

  • Experiência com Airflow ou outras ferramentas de orquestração.
  • Experiência com modelos preditivos simples (ex: churn, scoring, clustering).
  • Experiência em ambientes com DataOps ou MLOps.
  • Conhecimento em testes de dados (ex: dbt tests, Great Expectations).
  • Experiência explorando e analisando dados provenientes de múltiplas fontes, entendendo as demandas do negócio por meio de conversas com stakeholders.
  • Vivência traduzindo os resultados por meio de relatórios e dashboards em ferramentas como Looker ou Metabase.


Modelo de Contratação: PJ


Oferecemos:

  • Ajuda de custo para o remoto;
  • Bônus (Participação nos Resultados);
  • Day Off de aniversário;
  • Descanso remunerado;
  • Rotina remota de trabalho;
  • Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador;
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto.


Como se candidatar

Valorizamos perspectivas diversas e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes experiências. Se você é uma pessoa Engenheira de Dados e está buscando uma oportunidade desafiadora em uma empresa inovadora, se aplique pelo LinkedIn

title: Consultor JD Edwards (JDE)
description:
Sobre a Empresa

Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo:

title: Senior Content Manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.


This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.


To be more specific, you will:


  • Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
  • Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
  • Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
  • Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
  • Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
  • Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
  • Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
  • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
  • Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations
  • Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.


The ideal profile


We’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.


You are someone who:


  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it


You bring strong CM fundamentals:


  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
  • Experience working with CMS platforms


You work well with others and think ahead:


  • Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
  • Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
  • Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements
  • 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media
  • Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • A full time remote work environment.
  • A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
  • Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
  • Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
  • Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun . We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!

The infrared thermography product line ranges from sensors, modules to full-featured products.


Business Development Manager – Industrial Market


Country： Brazil

The Business Development Manager – Industrial Market should have large experience for developing Industrial market by approaching and building solid relationship with both Distributors and End Users.

The key attributes and expectations of a good Business Development Manager are:


•Great business sense and market sense

•Massive customer resource regarding industrial market

•Great communication skills

•The knowledge of Infrared Thermography or Flow Meter or Pressure Transmitter or Level Meter is preferred

•A positive attitude

•Great negotiation skills

•Initiative, Honesty and Integrity


Hikvision therefore requires the Business Development manager to act as the ambassador of the company and brand, delivering the following key tasks:


•Develop/Manager Industrial market, and carry out market research, competitor and customer surveys

•Find potential business opportunities and business growth points

•Approaching and establishing new, solid and long-term relationships with distributors and end users

•Presentation of the solution to potential customers

•Support marketing activities by attending trade shows, conferences and other marketing events.

•Work closely with colleagues in the regional sales team

•Perform lobbying in associations and interest groups.

•Assist consultants to specify projects

•Position HIKMICRO as the preferred product for consultants.

•Prepare reports required by the management.


Your Profile:


•Experience in the industrial market.

•Proven negotiation skills on cooperate level.

•Being open minded to working in a multi-cultural company.

•Being self-driven and ambitious to be part of a winning culture.

•The knowledge of Infrared Thermography or Flow Meter or Pressure Transmitter or Level Meter is preferred

•Strong communication skills in English，both oral and written

•Solid in Outlook and related products.

description:
Somos o Grupo Casas Bahia, com mais de 70 anos de história, realizando os sonhos de +100 milhões de brasileiros.


Aqui, somos protagonistas o tempo todo, sempre com integridade e ética em tudo o que fazemos. A paixão pela nossa gente é o que nos move, e a dedicação total ao cliente é o nosso compromisso diário. Entregamos resultados e buscamos sempre a simplicidade em tudo o que fazemos!


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa para atuar em modelo 100% remoto, integrando o time de Tecnologia. Esta pessoa terá um papel fundamental no desenho e evolução de uma plataforma escalável e governada, utilizando automação e agentes de IA, além de otimizar processos e operações em larga escala.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Acompanhar métricas de performance e a qualidade das entregas, promovendo melhoria contínua.
  • Prezar por um ambiente de trabalho ágil, colaborativo, orientado por métricas e focado na melhoria da jornada do cliente.
  • Apoiar a equipe na adoção de bons processos de desenvolvimento, garantindo alinhamento interno e com stakeholders, e entregas consistentes de software de qualidade.
  • Desenvolver estratégias de teste para garantir produtos com alta qualidade.
  • Identificar problemas e oportunidades, comunicando-os de forma clara às lideranças.
  • Automatizar testes com base em análise de riscos.
  • Apoiar o time de Qualidade com as melhores práticas de testes e automação.
  • Automatizar testes para diferentes sistemas (Front-end e Back-end).
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o time de desenvolvimento em ambiente ágil, participando de todas as fases do ciclo de desenvolvimento de software.


Requisitos e qualificações:


  • Conhecimento em técnicas de teste: caixa branca e caixa preta.
  • Experiência com uma ou mais das seguintes ferramentas: Ruby, Cypress, Selenium ou Cucumber.
  • Conhecimento em estratégia e gerenciamento de testes.
  • Experiência com métodos ágeis (BDD, Scrum e/ou Kanban).
  • Experiência com testes funcionais (regressão e exploratório).
  • Experiência na criação e manutenção de massa de dados para testes.


Seria muito legal se você tivesse:


  • Conhecimento em linguagens de programação.
  • Certificação na área de testes.
  • Experiência com testes não funcionais (performance, carga e acessibilidade).
  • Familiaridade com métricas e indicadores de performance.
  • Conhecimento em práticas de CI/CD (Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery).


Informações adicionais:

Local de Trabalho: Brasil | Remoto.

title: Analista de CRM Sênior
description:
Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)



Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso? Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um Super Analista de CRM Sênior , que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time de Revenue e que queira crescer (muito!) com a gente.



Responsabilidades


Como Analista Sênior, você será a referência técnica e estratégica do time de CRM. Seu papel será construir e manter relacionamentos estratégicos e sustentáveis entre a SuperFrete e seus clientes. Você será responsável por desenhar e implementar estratégias avançadas de personalização e comunicação, influenciando diretamente os resultados de conversão da empresa.



No dia a dia, você vai:


  • Estratégia e arquitetura de jornada: criar e implementar jornadas baseadas em dados unificados, mapeando processos de negócio para identificar gargalos e propor intervenções estratégicas que destravem valor.
  • Visão de dados: atuar na estratégia de unificação de dados dos clientes para garantir uma visão 360º, permitindo segmentações comportamentais avançadas e comunicações personalizadas.
  • Comunicação multicanal: idealizar campanhas que sejam relevantes para o momento do empreendedor, cuidando da narrativa e do impacto da mensagem em canais como WhatsApp, push, e-mail e SMS.
  • Uso estratégico do HubSpot: utilizar o potencial máximo das ferramentas de automação para viabilizar as estratégias de comunicação e otimizar as jornadas de relacionamento.
  • Experimentação e testes AB: liderar uma rotina de testes para descobrir constantemente novas alavancas de crescimento e conversão.
  • Análise e performance: monitorar KPIs de jornada e negócio através do HubSpot, Power BI e GA4, transformando dados em melhorias contínuas para a experiência do cliente.
  • Colaboração e mentoria: colaborar com as equipes de Marketing, Vendas, Produto e Atendimento para garantir a consistência dos processos; Apoiar o desenvolvimento do time de CRM compartilhando boas práticas.
  • Inovação e melhoria de processos: acompanhar tendências de mercado, propondo novas soluções tecnológicas e abordagens para escalar a personalização e aprimorar a experiência do cliente através da automação de processos.


Requisitos



  • Experiência avançada em HubSpot, com foco em automação de marketing e análise de jornada para viabilizar projetos de comunicação;
  • Domínio de estratégias de comunicação multicanal, incluindo WhatsApp, push, SMS e e-mail marketing, entendendo as particularidades e boas práticas de cada canal;
  • Habilidade em copywriting e narrativa, com capacidade de criar textos que engajam o pequeno e médio empreendedor, utilizando gatilhos e tom de voz adequados para conversão, além de desenvolver campanhas segmentadas e personalizadas com base no comportamento dos clientes;
  • Forte capacidade de análise de jornada e dados, com experiência na definição e monitoramento de KPIs de conversão e interpretação de dados para tomada de decisão;
  • Estratégia CDP & DMP: Compreensão de como a unificação de dados e a gestão de processos de negócio potencializam o CRM;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de mensuração e analytics, como Appsflyer, Firebase e GA4;
  • Experiência em gestão de projetos, com capacidade de estruturar e executar processos repetíveis, eficientes e escaláveis de forma colaborativa com diferentes áreas.



Diferenciais


  • Experiência em startups e/ou empresas de tecnologia;


O que você pode esperar dos Supers?


  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.



O que oferecemos

title: Administrador de sistema e banco de dados
description:
Administrador de Banco de Dados

Buscamos um Administrador de Banco de Dados qualificado para se juntar à nossa equipe. O candidato ideal deve possuir sólida experiência em MongoDB e Redis, e conhecimentos em PostgreSQL serão considerados um diferencial. Esta é uma oportunidade incrível para um profissional que deseja atuar em um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, contribuindo para a performance e segurança de nossos sistemas de dados.


Responsabilidades:

- Administrar e otimizar bancos de dados MongoDB e Redis, garantindo alta disponibilidade e desempenho.

title: Analista de CRM Sênior
description:
Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)



Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso? Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um Super Analista de CRM Sênior , que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time de Revenue e que queira crescer (muito!) com a gente.



Responsabilidades


Como Analista Sênior, você será a referência técnica e estratégica do time de CRM. Seu papel será construir e manter relacionamentos estratégicos e sustentáveis entre a SuperFrete e seus clientes. Você será responsável por desenhar e implementar estratégias avançadas de personalização e comunicação, influenciando diretamente os resultados de conversão da empresa.



No dia a dia, você vai:


  • Estratégia e arquitetura de jornada: criar e implementar jornadas baseadas em dados unificados, mapeando processos de negócio para identificar gargalos e propor intervenções estratégicas que destravem valor.
  • Visão de dados: atuar na estratégia de unificação de dados dos clientes para garantir uma visão 360º, permitindo segmentações comportamentais avançadas e comunicações personalizadas.
  • Comunicação multicanal: idealizar campanhas que sejam relevantes para o momento do empreendedor, cuidando da narrativa e do impacto da mensagem em canais como WhatsApp, push, e-mail e SMS.
  • Uso estratégico do HubSpot: utilizar o potencial máximo das ferramentas de automação para viabilizar as estratégias de comunicação e otimizar as jornadas de relacionamento.
  • Experimentação e testes AB: liderar uma rotina de testes para descobrir constantemente novas alavancas de crescimento e conversão.
  • Análise e performance: monitorar KPIs de jornada e negócio através do HubSpot, Power BI e GA4, transformando dados em melhorias contínuas para a experiência do cliente.
  • Colaboração e mentoria: colaborar com as equipes de Marketing, Vendas, Produto e Atendimento para garantir a consistência dos processos; Apoiar o desenvolvimento do time de CRM compartilhando boas práticas.
  • Inovação e melhoria de processos: acompanhar tendências de mercado, propondo novas soluções tecnológicas e abordagens para escalar a personalização e aprimorar a experiência do cliente através da automação de processos.


Requisitos



  • Experiência avançada em HubSpot, com foco em automação de marketing e análise de jornada para viabilizar projetos de comunicação;
  • Domínio de estratégias de comunicação multicanal, incluindo WhatsApp, push, SMS e e-mail marketing, entendendo as particularidades e boas práticas de cada canal;
  • Habilidade em copywriting e narrativa, com capacidade de criar textos que engajam o pequeno e médio empreendedor, utilizando gatilhos e tom de voz adequados para conversão, além de desenvolver campanhas segmentadas e personalizadas com base no comportamento dos clientes;
  • Forte capacidade de análise de jornada e dados, com experiência na definição e monitoramento de KPIs de conversão e interpretação de dados para tomada de decisão;
  • Estratégia CDP & DMP: Compreensão de como a unificação de dados e a gestão de processos de negócio potencializam o CRM;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de mensuração e analytics, como Appsflyer, Firebase e GA4;
  • Experiência em gestão de projetos, com capacidade de estruturar e executar processos repetíveis, eficientes e escaláveis de forma colaborativa com diferentes áreas.



Diferenciais


  • Experiência em startups e/ou empresas de tecnologia;


O que você pode esperar dos Supers?


  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.



O que oferecemos

Brazil

title: Cybersecurity Customer Success Manager - Brazil
description:
WHO ARE WE?

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!


CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.


Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:


CloudSEK’s Product Suite:

  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.

Key Milestones:

  • 2016 : Launched our first product.
  • 2018 : Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019 : Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020 : Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021 : Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition : Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025 : Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


Role Overview:

As a Customer Success Manager at CloudSEK, you will be the primary point of contact for a few strategic accounts, ensuring they derive maximum value from our cybersecurity solutions. Your role will involve deep engagement with clients, providing expert guidance on threat management, and ensuring seamless integration and utilization of CloudSEK’s products. Your background in cybersecurity will be crucial in understanding and addressing the specific needs and challenges faced by our clients.


Your mission->

I. Account Management:

  • Manage and nurture relationships for a client accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Annual Business Reviews (ABRs) to assess and enhance customer engagement.
  • Visit customers twice a year to strengthen relationships and understand their evolving needs.

II. Cybersecurity Expertise:

  • Provide expert guidance on threat intelligence, data leak prevention, and other cybersecurity issues.
  • Act as a security analyst, offering insights and recommendations based on threats generated by CloudSEK’s platform.
  • Collaborate with customer security teams to ensure optimal usage of CloudSEK’s solutions.

III. Customer Engagement:

  • Develop and execute customer engagement strategies to build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including CXOs and CISOs.
  • Foster customer champions within client organizations to drive advocacy and referrals.
  • Generate and share client-specific quality reports, gathering feedback to continuously improve service delivery.

IV. Revenue Generation and Retention:

  • Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling CloudSEK’s products and services.
  • Ensure on-time renewals and maintain a high customer retention rate.
  • Source referrals and participate in revenue generation activities.

V. Product Usage and Feedback:

  • Ensure 100% product usage for features subscribed by the customers.
  • Conduct configuration reviews and provide recommendations for product enhancements.
  • Gather and analyze customer feedback to contribute to product development and improvement.

VI. Operational Excellence:

  • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and activities in CRM systems.
  • Contribute to the team by sharing knowledge, conducting training sessions, and writing internal articles.


What we're looking for:

title: SAP S/4HANA Finance Consultant
description:
Genesis Consulting has an immediate opportunity for an experienced SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI) Consultant to support a global operation S/4HANA. The consultant will play a critical role in the implementation, configuration, and optimization of core financial processes within SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition. Our clients are some of the world’s leading companies and the candidate will be a part of challenging projects to build and support technical solutions for their needs.



The SAP S/4HANA FI Consultant will act as a functional utility player across the Finance workstream, supporting General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Funds Management, and integration with Procurement, Asset Management, and Payroll. The role requires hands-on participation across all phases of the implementation lifecycle, including design, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-go-live support.



The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to ensure financial processes are aligned to SAP S/4HANA best practices while supporting the client’s operational and regulatory requirements. This includes supporting the transition from ECC-based processes to S/4HANA capabilities, including Fiori-enabled user experiences and embedded analytics.



The FI Consultant will also assist in identifying opportunities to streamline legacy processes, reduce customizations, and leverage standard S/4HANA functionality, while ensuring continuity of critical financial operations during the system conversion.



Duties and Responsibilities:


The Consultant facilitates the implementation and support of SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions to enhance the client’s financial operations and overall system performance, while maintaining a high degree of customer satisfaction.


  • Configure and support SAP S/4HANA Finance components including GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting
  • Participate in fit-to-standard workshops and support design decisions aligned to S/4HANA best practices
  • Act as a cross-functional contributor, supporting integration points between Finance and modules such as MM (Procurement), EAM (Asset Management), HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Support the migration and validation of financial data, including balances, open items, and asset data during conversion activities
  • Assist in identifying and supporting remediation of custom code, reports, interfaces, and enhancements impacting Finance processes
  • Support Fiori application enablement, including validation of finance-related apps, roles, and user experience considerations
  • Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and defect resolution across financial and cross-functional scenarios
  • Collaborate with technical and data teams to support integration, reporting, and data reconciliation activities
  • Support cutover planning and execution, including financial readiness activities and validation of key processes
  • Provide post-go-live support and stabilization assistance for financial operations



Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

  • 3-5 years of SAP experience with a strong focus on Finance (FI) in ECC and S/4HANA environments
  • At least two full lifecycle SAP implementations, including at least one S/4HANA conversion or implementation
  • Hands-on experience with core FI modules including GL, AP, AR, and Asset Accounting
  • Functional integration experience with SAP modules including MM, EAM, HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Experience supporting financial data migration, reconciliation, and validation activities
  • Experience with SAP Fiori applications and understanding of role-based access and user experience
  • Experience supporting testing cycles including SIT and UAT in integrated SAP environments
  • Working knowledge of custom code impacts (reports, interfaces, enhancements) and ability to support functional validation
  • Experience with SAP reporting and analytics, including embedded analytics or BW-based reporting
  • Strong understanding of financial close processes, including month-end and year-end activities
  • Experience working in Agile or SAP Activate-based delivery models


Minimum Education:


  • Bachelor’s Degree – Preferred
  • Bachelor of Science or Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical/Computer Engineering or equivalent experience preferred or Accounting (preferred).



Required Certifications:


  • Certification in S/4 HANA, and/or other SAP Solutions is a plus.



Other:


  • Experience working in distributed delivery environments, including coordination with offshore or nearshore teams (e.g., LATAM delivery centers)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work directly with business stakeholders
  • Ability to support a hybrid delivery model with remote and on-site collaboration as required

title: Entitlement Engineer
description:
Position : Entitlement Engineer

Duration : Long Term Contract

Location : Brazil, Chille, Colombia ,Costa Rica-LATM

Pay Range: $22/hr - $24/hr



Day to Day:

Insight Global is seeking an IAM Engineer with strong SAP GRC Access Control expertise to support identity and access governance across Tenneco / DRiV’s SAP environments. This individual will manage and enhance SAP GRC capabilities across multiple landscapes, ensure access controls meet audit and compliance standards, and partner closely with security, compliance, and business stakeholders.


Specific Responsibilities:

  • SAP GRC Administration:
  • Manage, administer, and control SAP GRC Access Control across multiple landscapes (DEV / QA / PRD)
  • GRC Configuration & Support:
  • Configure, maintain, and support SAP GRC modules, including ARA, ARM, and EAM
  • Troubleshoot workflow failures and access provisioning issues
  • Workflow & Rules Management:
  • Design, configure, and maintain BRF+ rules and MSMP workflows for access requests and approvals
  • SAP Role Management:
  • Perform SAP role design, build, maintenance, and remediation across SAP systems
  • Support user provisioning, de-provisioning, and role changes in compliance with internal controls
  • SoD & Risk Management:
  • Conduct Segregation of Duties analysis, remediation, and mitigation
  • Collaborate with business and application owners to resolve access risks
  • Audit & Compliance Support:
  • Provide access reports, logs, and audit evidence from SAP GRC
  • Partner with security, audit, and compliance teams during reviews and remediation efforts
  • Continuous Improvement:
  • Participate in system upgrades, enhancements, and ongoing IAM/GRC process improvements


Qualifications :

  • Bachelor’s degree required or equivalent professional experience
  • 6–7+ years of experience in IAM Engineering roles
  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP GRC Access Control (implementation and production support required)
  • Experience across multiple GRC landscapes (DEV / QA / PRD)
  • In-depth experience with the following SAP GRC modules:
  • Access Risk Analysis (ARA)
  • Access Request Management (ARM)
  • Emergency Access Management (EAM / Firefighter)
  • Strong knowledge of BRF+ rules design and MSMP workflow configuration
  • Extensive experience in SAP role design, build, remediation, and maintenance
  • Single and composite roles
  • SAP authorization concepts (SU24, roles, profiles)
  • Experience conducting Segregation of Duties (SoD) analysis and remediation
  • Proven experience supporting audits and partnering with compliance teams
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities
  • Experience supporting large manufacturing, automotive, or global enterprise environments


Preferred Qualifications:

  • SAP Security and/or SAP GRC certifications
  • Experience in large, global enterprise SAP environments
  • Familiarity with additional SAP platforms and modules
  • ECC, S/4HANA, Fiori Security





**Exact compensation may vary based on several factors, including skills, experience, and education.

**Benefit packages for this role will start on the 31st day of employment and include medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as HSA, FSA, and DCFSA account options, and 401k retirement account access with employer matching. Employees in this role are also entitled to paid sick leave and/or other paid time off as provided by applicable law.

programmatic platforms. This role is ideal for someone with hands-on experience implementing and

maintaining campaigns across DSPs like BeesWax, Yahoo, Amazon, The Trade Desk, DV360, Moloco, and similar.

readiness.

advertising.

title: Cybersecurity Customer Success Manager - Brazil
description:
WHO ARE WE?

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!


CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.


Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:


CloudSEK’s Product Suite:

  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.

Key Milestones:

  • 2016 : Launched our first product.
  • 2018 : Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019 : Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020 : Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021 : Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition : Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025 : Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


Role Overview:

As a Customer Success Manager at CloudSEK, you will be the primary point of contact for a few strategic accounts, ensuring they derive maximum value from our cybersecurity solutions. Your role will involve deep engagement with clients, providing expert guidance on threat management, and ensuring seamless integration and utilization of CloudSEK’s products. Your background in cybersecurity will be crucial in understanding and addressing the specific needs and challenges faced by our clients.


Your mission->

I. Account Management:

  • Manage and nurture relationships for a client accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Annual Business Reviews (ABRs) to assess and enhance customer engagement.
  • Visit customers twice a year to strengthen relationships and understand their evolving needs.

II. Cybersecurity Expertise:

  • Provide expert guidance on threat intelligence, data leak prevention, and other cybersecurity issues.
  • Act as a security analyst, offering insights and recommendations based on threats generated by CloudSEK’s platform.
  • Collaborate with customer security teams to ensure optimal usage of CloudSEK’s solutions.

III. Customer Engagement:

  • Develop and execute customer engagement strategies to build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including CXOs and CISOs.
  • Foster customer champions within client organizations to drive advocacy and referrals.
  • Generate and share client-specific quality reports, gathering feedback to continuously improve service delivery.

IV. Revenue Generation and Retention:

  • Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling CloudSEK’s products and services.
  • Ensure on-time renewals and maintain a high customer retention rate.
  • Source referrals and participate in revenue generation activities.

V. Product Usage and Feedback:

  • Ensure 100% product usage for features subscribed by the customers.
  • Conduct configuration reviews and provide recommendations for product enhancements.
  • Gather and analyze customer feedback to contribute to product development and improvement.

VI. Operational Excellence:

  • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and activities in CRM systems.
  • Contribute to the team by sharing knowledge, conducting training sessions, and writing internal articles.


What we're looking for:

  • 4-5 years of experience in Cybersecurity, Client-facing experience, or a related role in the cybersecurity industry.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat intelligence, and digital risk management.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with clients.
  • Proven track record of achieving customer success goals and driving revenue growth.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple accounts simultaneously.


Cookie points if you have experience in the below skills:

  • Business reviews
  • Onsite meetings
  • Maintaining NRR and GRR
  • Threat analysis and Value delivery


Benefits of Joining CloudSEK

We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You’ll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include:

  • Flexible working hours.
  • Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office.

And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here!


CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Cybersecurity Customer Success Manager - Brazil
description:
WHO ARE WE?

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!


CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.


Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:


CloudSEK’s Product Suite:

  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.

Key Milestones:

  • 2016 : Launched our first product.
  • 2018 : Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019 : Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020 : Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021 : Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition : Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025 : Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


Role Overview:

As a Customer Success Manager at CloudSEK, you will be the primary point of contact for a few strategic accounts, ensuring they derive maximum value from our cybersecurity solutions. Your role will involve deep engagement with clients, providing expert guidance on threat management, and ensuring seamless integration and utilization of CloudSEK’s products. Your background in cybersecurity will be crucial in understanding and addressing the specific needs and challenges faced by our clients.


Your mission->

I. Account Management:

  • Manage and nurture relationships for a client accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Annual Business Reviews (ABRs) to assess and enhance customer engagement.
  • Visit customers twice a year to strengthen relationships and understand their evolving needs.

II. Cybersecurity Expertise:

  • Provide expert guidance on threat intelligence, data leak prevention, and other cybersecurity issues.
  • Act as a security analyst, offering insights and recommendations based on threats generated by CloudSEK’s platform.
  • Collaborate with customer security teams to ensure optimal usage of CloudSEK’s solutions.

III. Customer Engagement:

  • Develop and execute customer engagement strategies to build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including CXOs and CISOs.
  • Foster customer champions within client organizations to drive advocacy and referrals.
  • Generate and share client-specific quality reports, gathering feedback to continuously improve service delivery.

IV. Revenue Generation and Retention:

  • Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling CloudSEK’s products and services.
  • Ensure on-time renewals and maintain a high customer retention rate.
  • Source referrals and participate in revenue generation activities.

V. Product Usage and Feedback:

  • Ensure 100% product usage for features subscribed by the customers.
  • Conduct configuration reviews and provide recommendations for product enhancements.
  • Gather and analyze customer feedback to contribute to product development and improvement.

VI. Operational Excellence:

  • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and activities in CRM systems.
  • Contribute to the team by sharing knowledge, conducting training sessions, and writing internal articles.


What we're looking for:

  • 4-5 years of experience in Cybersecurity, Client-facing experience, or a related role in the cybersecurity industry.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat intelligence, and digital risk management.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with clients.
  • Proven track record of achieving customer success goals and driving revenue growth.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple accounts simultaneously.


Cookie points if you have experience in the below skills:

  • Business reviews
  • Onsite meetings
  • Maintaining NRR and GRR
  • Threat analysis and Value delivery


Benefits of Joining CloudSEK

We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You’ll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include:

  • Flexible working hours.
  • Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office.

And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here!


CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Ad Operations Specialist
description:
Ad Operations and Trafficking Specialist



AdLib is looking for a DSP Ad Operations and Trafficking Specialist to support our brand and agency partners by ensuring flawless campaign setup, trafficking, QA, and delivery execution across multiple

programmatic platforms. This role is ideal for someone with hands-on experience implementing and

maintaining campaigns across DSPs like BeesWax, Yahoo, Amazon, The Trade Desk, DV360, Moloco, and similar.

readiness.

correctly and on time.

• Strong understanding of trafficking workflows, pacing, and QA processes in programmatic

advertising.

• Experience troubleshooting delivery, tracking, and technical issues across platforms.

• Familiarity with analytics and measurement tools such as Northbeam, Triple Whale, Appsflyer, and Google Analytics is a plus.

• Detail-oriented mindset with excellent organizational and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to manage multiple active campaigns in a fast-paced, remote work environment.



What We Offer

  • Competitive salary (dependent on region)
  • Fully paid medical, dental, and vision benefits
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Flexible, remote-first culture
  • Coworking space allowance
  • Gym membership reimbursement
  • Mobile phone plan reimbursement

Join us at AdLib and help agencies and brands scale their programmatic media buying smarter, faster, and more profitably

title: Analista de Segurança da Informação II
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro , maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina , e a Fisia , distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades:


-Monitoramento e Resposta (SOC): Atuar como ponto focal em incidentes críticos, realizando análise forense inicial e contenção de ameaças;

- Engenharia de Detecção (SIEM): Criar, tunar e otimizar regras de correlação no SIEM para reduzir falsos positivos e aumentar a visibilidade sobre ataques modernos;

- Inteligência de Ameaças (Threat Intel): Coletar e analisar IOCs (Indicadores de Comprometimento) e TTPs (Táticas, Técnicas e Procedimentos), convertendo inteligência bruta em ações de defesa proativa;

- Gestão de Vulnerabilidades: Liderar o ciclo de vida de vulnerabilidades, desde a varredura e priorização (baseada em risco e exploitability) até o acompanhamento da remediação com os times de infraestrutura e dev;

- Hunting: Realizar buscas proativas por ameaças que possam ter passado despercebidas pelos controles automáticos.


Requisitos Técnicos:

- SIEM: Experiência avançada em plataformas como Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Elastic Security ou QRadar (criação de dashboards e KQL/SPL);

- Frameworks: Domínio do MITRE ATT&CK e NIST Incident Response;

- Threat Intel: Conhecimento em plataformas de TI (MISP, OpenCTI) e consumo de feeds de inteligência;

- Vulnerability Management: Operação de ferramentas como Tenable.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Uma das pioneiras em soluções de inteligência de dados no Open Finance, a klavi é uma das instituições que mais cresce nesse ecossistema, levando inovação através de dados a milhares de brasileiros. A klavi utiliza tecnologia própria e de ponta para viabilizar a coleta de dados, além de automatizar todo o processamento desses dados para transformá-los em valor de negócio.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de QA com foco em garantir a qualidade, confiabilidade e desempenho das soluções desenvolvidas pela Klavi. Essa pessoa atuará de forma colaborativa com os times de produto e engenharia, contribuindo para a definição de cenários de teste, automação de testes, identificação e prevenção de bugs em todas as etapas do desenvolvimento. O objetivo é assegurar que nossas entregas atendam aos mais altos padrões de qualidade, proporcionando uma excelente experiência para os usuários finais.


Cultura da klavi

  • Busca constante pela excelência: Somos automotivados, nunca satisfeitos e sempre buscando melhorias. Cada pessoa deve ser um especialista na empresa e em seu segmento. Nós elevamos continuamente o nível para fornecer produtos, serviços e processos de alta qualidade.
  • Inovar para revolucionar: Encorajamos as pessoas a serem curiosas e a desafiarem o status quo. Ouvimos sempre novas ideias e estamos abertos a perguntas. Não temos medo de mudanças.
  • Construção e valorização coletiva: Colabore com seus colegas e celebrem juntos as vitórias. Sejam transparentes, respeitosos e confiem uns nos outros. Nós não reclamamos, mas encontramos soluções juntos.
  • Foco no sucesso do cliente: Nosso sucesso está enraizado no sucesso dos nossos clientes. Sempre nos esforçamos para superar suas expectativas. Buscamos fornecer as melhores soluções e valores a longo prazo.


Salário

  • Regime: PJ
  • Salário: Competitivo
  • Nível: Especialista


Principais responsabilidades

  • Investigar e diagnosticar falhas, identificando a causa raiz de bugs e inconsistências no sistema.
  • Criar suítes de testes com base nos requisitos funcionais e não funcionais das features.
  • Implementar testes automatizados para garantir a cobertura e a confiabilidade de novas funcionalidades.
  • Validar o estado do sistema antes de implantações, garantindo que todos os ambientes estejam estáveis e prontos para release.
  • Ter um entendimento profundo dos fluxos atuais do sistema para antecipar riscos e propor melhorias de qualidade.
  • Monitorar continuamente a saúde e o desempenho das aplicações, atuando preventivamente em casos de instabilidade.

Requisitos necessários:

  • Inglês avançado – Será necessário para se comunicar com times internacionais, participar de reuniões técnicas e colaborar em projetos globais.
  • Formação acadêmica na área de computação – Graduação completa ou em andamento em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com os testes automatizados
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho presencial – Atuação no escritório da Klavi em São Paulo, em modelo híbrido ou presencial, conforme combinado.
  • Tech Stack: Python, Java, Golang, AWS (EKS, SQS, SNS), PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, Git, Jenkins, Grafana


Nossos benefícios:

  • Plano de saúde, Plano Odontológico e Seguro de Vida;

  • Licença Parental estendida: a licença maternidade é de 6 meses e a licença parental é de 30 dias;
  • Auxílio Creche;

  • Gympass;

  • Chat GPT Pro;
  • Bônus.

title: SAP SD Techno Functional Consultant
description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. The SAP SD Techno‑Functional Consultant is responsible for designing, configuring, and delivering SAP Sales & Distribution solutions, along with managing technical enhancements through ABAP knowledge.   • Ability to debug ABAP code to perform issue analysis.
  • Create Functional Design Documents (FDD), and review Technical Design Documents (TDD).


Language Requirement:

Advanced English

description:
Location: Remote

About the Role

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented SAP Procure to Pay and Record to Report Tax Specialist to join our client's team in the technology sector. In this role, you will contribute to analyzing, configuring, testing, deploying, and supporting SAP solutions, ensuring accurate localization for Brazilian and Mexican legal requirements, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to align local tax and statutory requirements with global standard processes.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze, configure, test, deploy, and support SAP ECC and S/4 HANA solutions focused on PTP and RTR, especially as they relate to Procurement, Finance, and Tax processes for Brazil and Mexico.
  • Make recommendations for improving business processes and technology enablement, particularly around local tax compliance and statutory reporting.
  • Ensure accurate localization of SAP solutions to comply with Brazilian and Mexican legal and fiscal requirements.
  • Develop standard business process design, configure, test, deploy and support SAP ECC and S/4 HANA solutions.
  • Effectively communicate and collaborate with Procurement, Finance, Tax, IT Business Partners, and Senior Leadership.
  • Resolve integration points between RTR, Procure to Pay (PTP), Order to Cash (OTC), and Treasury processes.
  • Support daily operations for SAP Procurement, Finance, and Tax processes, including issue resolution, user support, and change management.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align local tax and statutory requirements with global standard processes.
  • Utilize technical and functional expertise to support Procurement, Finance, and Tax initiatives.
  • Participate in or lead projects implementing or upgrading tax localization and compliance solutions.

Requirements

  • Deep knowledge of procurement and financial operations, tax calculation, and compliance reporting within the Brazilian and Mexican legislative environments.
  • Experience with SAP ECC and S/4 HANA solutions.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with various business stakeholders.
  • Ability to make decisions applicable to the level of influence in the organization.
  • Senior-level experience in a similar role.

Preferred Qualifications (if any)

  • Experience with tax calculation engines, e-invoicing, and withholding tax management.

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:

Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world.   • Contribute to roadmap discussions and long-term quality vision

  • Mentor other QA engineers and strengthen onboarding and technical standards

Technical

  • Ability to troubleshoot complex issues across the full stack
  • Experience improving automation reliability and non-functional coverage
  • Strategic thinking around scalability and long-term maintainability.

title: Cloudbees DevOps Engineer
description:
Cloudbees DevOps Engineer – Help Shape the Future of Continuous Delivery at a Global Financial Technology Leader!


Join a mission-critical engineering organisation at the heart of one of the world’s most influential financial messaging and payments platforms. Become part of a global DevOps Engineering Services team enabling modern software delivery, automation, and orchestration across a highly complex, secure, and fast-moving technology landscape. Supporting internal engineering teams across the enterprise, you’ll contribute to a mature and rapidly expanding initiative driving CI/CD/RO adoption - powering over 100+ applications and accelerating delivery excellence for teams primarily across the United States.


This is your opportunity to work inside a global organisation transforming the way software is built, released, and operated - while collaborating with senior engineers and DevOps experts across continents.


Your Role as a Cloudbees DevOps Engineer

As a DevOps Engineer within the DevOps Engineering Services team, you’ll help deliver internal tooling, automation, and release orchestration capabilities that empower hundreds of developers and application teams.

Working in a transversal function, you’ll support the rollout and optimisation of CloudBees Release Orchestration (RO) and CI/CD best practices, ensuring smooth adoption and consistent execution across the organisation. You'll contribute to a mature programme governed by senior engineers, with clear guidance, structured delivery, and high-impact outcomes across enterprise DevOps environments.


What You’ll Do

  • Support adoption of CI/CD and RO tooling across internal DevOps teams
  • Work closely with Senior Engineers to execute release orchestration onboarding tasks
  • Assist in scaling the enterprise adoption of CloudBees RO, Jenkins, CloudBees CI/CD
  • Enable best practices for Git workflows, artefact management (Nexus), and code quality (SonarQube)
  • Support SAST/DAST integration within secure delivery pipelines
  • Provide technical support to internal teams as they adopt enterprise DevOps tooling
  • Contribute to IaC and automation efforts using Python and Ansible Automation Platform
  • Support containerisation initiatives using Docker and OpenShift/Kubernetes
  • Collaborate in an Agile, DevSecOps-driven environment to standardise delivery processes
  • Ensure accurate documentation, repeatable execution, and alignment to engineering guidelines


What You Bring

  • 4+ years of DevOps engineering experience
  • Hands-on expertise with CI/CD tooling, ideally CloudBees.
  • Hands on experience with Jenkins, Git, Nexus, SonarQube
  • Experience with SAST/DAST tools
  • Practical development experience in Java/Maven or C++
  • Exposure to infrastructure automation using Python and Ansible
  • Knowledge of containerisation: Docker, OpenShift/Kubernetes
  • Strong understanding of Agile and DevSecOps principles
  • Excellent English communication skills (client teams are primarily US-based)
  • Ability to follow established engineering patterns and execute with precision

title: Retention Account Manager
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 50 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle—from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As an Retention Account Manager at Lilo Social, you will serve as the primary retention marketing contact for 7-10 client accounts, ensuring seamless execution and delivery of email and SMS programs. You will bridge the gap between strategic vision and tactical execution, coordinating with designers, copywriters, and strategists to deliver high-quality retention campaigns that drive repeat purchases and customer lifetime value. This role requires exceptional organizational skills, deep platform expertise, and the ability to build trusted client relationships through reliable communication and flawless execution.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent on-time delivery of retention campaigns and flows with zero quality issues across your client portfolio
  • High client satisfaction scores and retention through proactive communication and strategic support
  • Efficient project coordination that enables your team to meet ambitious deliverable timelines
  • Strong retention performance metrics (revenue per recipient, list growth, engagement rates) driven by execution excellence and strategic QA


Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for retention marketing across 7-10 assigned client accounts, managing all communication via Slack and email
  • Prepare for and participate in client calls (monthly or bi-weekly), providing retention performance updates, execution status reports, and tactical recommendations while supporting senior strategists
  • Translate client retention goals and strategic direction into clear, actionable deliverables for internal teams including designers, copywriters, and developers
  • Manage end-to-end project coordination in Asana, creating tasks, tracking progress, and ensuring on-time delivery without managing team capacity or resource allocation
  • Conduct comprehensive QA on all email campaigns, SMS messages, and lifecycle flows before launch to ensure accuracy, functionality, brand consistency, and technical performance
  • Monitor retention performance metrics using Klaviyo, Hiro, and platform analytics, preparing performance summaries and identifying optimization opportunities
  • Maintain deep expertise in Klaviyo and SMS platforms (Attentive, Postscript), staying current on platform updates, retention best practices, and deliverability standards
  • Troubleshoot technical issues across email flows, campaign deployment, segmentation logic, and deliverability concerns
  • Oversee list growth initiatives, on-site capture optimization, and popup strategy to drive subscriber acquisition
  • Document all client action items, requests, and deliverable changes, converting them into trackable tasks with clear ownership
  • Flag client concerns, technical blockers, or strategic questions early to internal leadership for resolution
  • Support account renewals and expansion opportunities through exceptional execution and client relationship management


Requirements

  • 3-5 years of experience in email marketing, retention marketing, or account management within DTC ecommerce or agency environments
  • Expert-level proficiency in Klaviyo, including campaign management, flow architecture, segmentation, deliverability optimization, and analytics
  • Experience with SMS marketing platforms such as Attentive, Postscript, or similar tools
  • Proven track record managing multiple client accounts simultaneously (ideally 5-10 accounts) with strong organizational capabilities
  • Deep understanding of retention marketing principles including lifecycle flows, campaign strategy, customer segmentation, and LTV optimization
  • Strong project management skills with experience using tools like Asana, ClickUp, Monday, or Notion
  • Excellent client communication abilities with a professional, proactive, and service-oriented approach
  • Technical knowledge of email deliverability, list hygiene, sender reputation, and technical email best practices


Nice to Have

  • Agency experience managing multiple DTC brands with varying retention strategies and needs
  • Experience with Hiro or other email analytics and attribution platforms
  • QA or quality assurance background with systematic testing approaches
  • Strategic thinking abilities to identify upsell opportunities and retention program expansion
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce platform integrations
  • Experience supporting or managing retention programs generating $100K+ monthly attributed revenue


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere within EST to PST hours with a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer


We are looking for a Senior Developer Data Engineer to build and operate scalable data pipelines and curated datasets that enable Digital and Customer Experience Applications across a global FMCG enterprise. You will work hands on with Python, PySpark, Databricks and SQL contribute to modern engineering practices using Gitbased workflows and CI/CD to support end to end delivery through Azure DevOps.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and optimize ETL ELT pipelines using Databricks, PySpark to ingest, transform and serve data for digital customer experience.
  • Build and maintain highquality performant SQL transformations and dimensional curated data layers for analytics and downstream consumption.
  • Implement best practices for Databricks engineering notebooks vs repos modular code cluster job configuration, performance tuning and cost awareness.
  • Use Python for data processing utilities validations orchestration helpers and reusable libraries.
  • Manage source control using Git with enterprise workflows across GitHub Bitbucket enforce PR reviews branching strategies and coding standards.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps automating testing packaging and deployment of data code artifacts across environments.
  • Ensure data quality and reliability through validations reconciliation, checks monitoring and operational runbooks.
  • Collaborate with product app teams analysts and platform teams to translate requirements into scalable data products aligned to customer experience journeys.
  • For Senior Developer lead module level design, mentor engineers drive standards for CI/CD and code quality and own delivery for critical pipelines.


Requirements

  • Strong handson experience with: Python, PySpark, Databricks, jobs workflows, clusters repos, SQL advanced querying optimization.
  • Strong experience with Git and repository platforms, GitHub and/or Bitbucket.
  • Hands on experience implementing CI/CD for data engineering workloads.
  • Strong working experience with Azure DevOps, Boards Repos Pipelines, build release workflows.
  • English for reading, writing and verbal communication directly with foreigners.


If this sounds like the next challenge for you, apply now with an updated resume in English and we'll take it from here :)

title: Senior Electrical BIM Engineer
description:
Eracore is an electrical engineering and BIM company delivering complex Electrical BIM models for large construction projects across the U.S. Our team brings together top talent to work on some of the most interesting and technically demanding electrical projects, including data centers, government facilities, industrial buildings, and advanced commercial projects.


We are proud of the work we do, and we invite you to take a look:

Eracore is growing in Brazil , and we are excited to welcome new team members. We are building a permanent and professional team to work on Electrical BIM projects for the U.S. market. If you enjoy teamwork, learning, and doing quality work, you will feel at home with us.


Why You’ll Enjoy Working at Eracore

  • Competitive hourly pay
  • Continuing Education
  • Sports & Fitness
  • Fully remote work
  • Healthy work–life balance
  • Learning platforms for professional growth
  • Supportive leadership and mentorship


Your Role

  • Perform hands-on VDC and Electrical BIM production, including modeling, coordination, shop drawings, and prefabrication deliverables.
  • Ensure all work complies with design intent, NEC codes, and client requirements.
  • Take full ownership of assigned tasks and deliverables with minimal supervision.
  • Identify and resolve clashes and coordination issues and support the development of coordination-ready drawings.
  • Manage tasks, project schedules, and internal deadlines effectively.
  • Participate in client coordination meetings to align design intent, standards, and technical requirements.
  • Support RFIs and technical clarifications as required.
  • Provide technical guidance, coaching, and oversight to junior and mid-level engineers.
  • Maintain strong proficiency in Revit, Navisworks, Evolve, and other required VDC tools.


What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience in Electrical BIM
  • Strong understanding of electrical systems
  • Advanced Revit skills with an electrical focus
  • Experience using Navisworks for coordination and clash detection
  • Familiarity with BIM 360, ACC, and Bluebeam
  • Team-oriented mindset with mentoring experience
  • Reliable, organized, and deadline-focused
  • Spoken and technical written Intermediate English

title: Senior Full Stack Java - React Developer
description:
Senior Full Stack Java - React Developer

Brazil

Senior Software Engineer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary


As a Senior Full Stack Java - React Developer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining high-quality software solutions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable and efficient software applications. Your role will involve leading technical projects, mentoring junior engineers, and continuously improving software development practices to ensure the delivery of robust and reliable software systems.


Responsibilities and Duties


  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable full-stack applications using React, TypeScript, Java, and Spring Boot across frontend and backend layers;
  • Architect and implement robust RESTful APIs, real-time data integrations, and high-performance backend services with proper caching and optimization strategies;
  • Build modern, responsive, and highly interactive user interfaces, integrating streaming data, advanced search, and filtering capabilities;
  • Contribute to system design decisions, code reviews, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native deployments while ensuring high engineering standards and best practices.


Essential Skills


  • Experience with strong full-stack expertise in both frontend and backend;
  • Advanced proficiency in React, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript (ES6+), including strong CSS skills (Flexbox, Grid, responsive design);
  • Experience with UI frameworks such as MUI, Tailwind, or Ant Design, and solid frontend testing experience;
  • Strong expertise in Java and Spring Boot, designing and building scalable, secure RESTful APIs;
  • Experience with relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Redis);
  • Strong understanding of system design principles, caching mechanisms, and performance optimization in distributed systems;
  • Experience integrating REST APIs and real-time or streaming data solutions;
  • Hands-on experience with message brokers such as Kafka and search technologies like Elasticsearch;
  • Experience working with Kubernetes and cloud platforms (AWS preferred; GCP, Azure, or OCI acceptable);
  • Strong knowledge of Git and GitHub workflows (branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews) and CI/CD pipelines including GitHub Actions.



About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.
