title: Técnica de enfermagem
description:
No Grupo Nilo Frantz , lidamos com o bem mais precioso das pessoas: o sonho de gerar uma vida. Somos referência em excelência técnica, mas o nosso maior diferencial é o cuidado humano. Acreditamos que a tecnologia mais avançada precisa vir acompanhada do olhar mais acolhedor.

Se você é apaixonada pelo cuidado e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que ajuda a transformar o sonho de construir uma família em realidade? Estamos buscando uma Técnica em Enfermagem para compor nosso time assistencial!


Sobre a vaga:

Atuar no atendimento às necessidades dos pacientes da clínica no que tange aos cuidados de enfermagem. Isso inclui o acolhimento, orientações sobre o uso de medicações e chamadas para procedimentos. Você também irá auxiliar os médicos nos procedimentos do bloco cirúrgico, ecografias, entre outros.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Acompanhar os pacientes durante a realização de exames de imagem e aferir os sinais vitais na sala de recuperação;
  • Auxiliar diretamente a equipe médica nos procedimentos do bloco cirúrgico e nas ecografias;
  • Realizar a higienização dos materiais do centro cirúrgico e encaminhá-los para esterilização;
  • Manter a ordem nas salas de coleta e medicamentos;
  • Controlar os estoques de gelox, isopores e medicações;
  • Realizar o envio de materiais para o laboratório;
  • Arquivar pastas e prontuários de forma organizada;
  • Receber e acompanhar os exames enviados pelos pacientes.


O que buscamos em você:

Formação completa em Técnico de Enfermagem com COREN ativo e regular.

Organização, atenção aos detalhes e proatividade para lidar com as rotinas do bloco cirúrgico e salas de apoio.


Skills: Empatia, escuta ativa e postura acolhedora. O nosso ambiente exige delicadeza e sensibilidade no trato com os pacientes.


O que oferecemos:

  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação (cartão Ifood)
  • Vale transporte
  • Wellhub (benefício de academia)
  • Plano de saúde
  • Regime de contratação: CLT
  • Vaga presencial: Seg. a Sex. - 08h às 17h e sábados - 07h45 às 12h (por escala).
  • Local de trabalho: Av. Nilo Peçanha, 1221 – Porto Alegre/RS.

*Vaga exclusiva para mulheres.


Gostou da oportunidade e se identifica com o nosso propósito? Envie seu currículo atualizado.

title: Analista / Consultor(a) Oracle EBS Financials (FA) — PIS/COFINS
description:
Analista / Consultor Oracle Financials (FA) — PIS/COFINS

Especialista em ERP Financeiro com foco em apuração e adequação às novas regras de PIS/COFINS

Sobre a oportunidade

Buscamos um profissional com sólida experiência em Oracle Financials (FA) para atuar em um projeto estratégico de análise e adequação do sistema ERP às novas regras de PIS/COFINS. O ambiente é de sistema não nativo, com alto volume de customizações, exigindo capacidade analítica para entender o estado atual da solução, identificar gaps e propor as adaptações necessárias para conformidade fiscal.


Principais responsabilidades

Analisar o funcionamento atual do sistema ERP Oracle FA no que tange ao processo de apuração de PIS/COFINS, mapeando fluxos, regras de negócio e customizações existentes.

Identificar gaps entre a situação atual do sistema e os requisitos exigidos pela nova legislação de PIS/COFINS, propondo soluções de adequação.

Trabalhar com regime misto de apuração (cumulativo e não cumulativo), com foco especial na tomada de crédito pelas entradas.

Especificar e acompanhar as customizações e adaptações sistêmicas necessárias para atender às novas obrigações fiscais, em parceria com equipes técnicas e de desenvolvimento.

Documentar processos de negócio e requisitos funcionais (AS IS / TO BE), garantindo rastreabilidade das decisões e aderência à legislação vigente.

Apoiar testes, homologação e validação das entregas sistêmicas, assegurando conformidade tributária e integridade dos dados fiscais.


Diferenciais desejáveis

Experiência anterior em projetos de adequação fiscal e reforma tributária em sistemas ERP.

Conhecimento em SPED Contribuições (EFD-Contribuições) e obrigações acessórias relacionadas.

Noções de SQL para análise e validação de dados em ambiente Oracle.

Graduação em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

title: Analista / Consultor(a) Oracle EBS Financials (FA) — PIS/COFINS
description:
Analista / Consultor Oracle Financials (FA) — PIS/COFINS

Especialista em ERP Financeiro com foco em apuração e adequação às novas regras de PIS/COFINS

Sobre a oportunidade

Buscamos um profissional com sólida experiência em Oracle Financials (FA) para atuar em um projeto estratégico de análise e adequação do sistema ERP às novas regras de PIS/COFINS. O ambiente é de sistema não nativo, com alto volume de customizações, exigindo capacidade analítica para entender o estado atual da solução, identificar gaps e propor as adaptações necessárias para conformidade fiscal.


Principais responsabilidades

Analisar o funcionamento atual do sistema ERP Oracle FA no que tange ao processo de apuração de PIS/COFINS, mapeando fluxos, regras de negócio e customizações existentes.

Identificar gaps entre a situação atual do sistema e os requisitos exigidos pela nova legislação de PIS/COFINS, propondo soluções de adequação.

Trabalhar com regime misto de apuração (cumulativo e não cumulativo), com foco especial na tomada de crédito pelas entradas.

Especificar e acompanhar as customizações e adaptações sistêmicas necessárias para atender às novas obrigações fiscais, em parceria com equipes técnicas e de desenvolvimento.

Documentar processos de negócio e requisitos funcionais (AS IS / TO BE), garantindo rastreabilidade das decisões e aderência à legislação vigente.

Apoiar testes, homologação e validação das entregas sistêmicas, assegurando conformidade tributária e integridade dos dados fiscais.


Diferenciais desejáveis

Experiência anterior em projetos de adequação fiscal e reforma tributária em sistemas ERP.

Conhecimento em SPED Contribuições (EFD-Contribuições) e obrigações acessórias relacionadas.

Noções de SQL para análise e validação de dados em ambiente Oracle.

Graduação em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

title: SAP Data Migration Expert
description:

  • Strong knowledge of SAP BODS or comparable ETL tools

  • Good stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Experience in pharmaceutical or other regulated industries is advantageous

Contract Details

  • B2B engagement running through to September 2026 - strong chance of extension
  • Paid in USD (up to $40/hr)
  • Mostly remote with occasional office visits when required
  • Immediate start

title: AI Agent Manager (Media)
description:
About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose

The AI Agent Manager serves as the key technical and strategic resource for the company’s AI applications, with a focus on designing, building, operating, and managing complex AI agents. This role translates high-level business requirements into functional AI agent architectures, manages the full agent lifecycle (including advanced prompting, tooling, maintenance, and performance optimization), and ensures robust, measurable business outcomes.

The Manager owns the agent-building roadmap, advanced prompt engineering, agent configuration and deployment, performance monitoring, and cross-functional coordination to drive successful AI adoption across the organization.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Main Responsibilities
  • Design, build, and maintain AI-powered workflows and agents using low-code/no-code and prompt-based platforms (e.g., multi-step prompt systems, agent frameworks).
  • Translate business requirements into scalable AI-driven solutions, especially for internal process automation (e.g., media planning, operations, finance workflows).
  • Configure and optimize multi-step AI prompts (“blueprints”) to automate complex tasks across different tools and systems.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to understand use cases and define solution logic.
  • Act as a bridge between business teams and technical infrastructure, ensuring solutions are usable by non-technical users.
  • Test, iterate, and improve AI agents to ensure reliability, accuracy, and performance in real-world use cases.
  • Identify opportunities for automation across departments and proactively propose AI-driven improvements.
  • Document workflows, prompt logic, and system configurations for internal reuse and scalability.
  • Stay up to date with advancements in AI tools, LLM capabilities, and no-code/low-code ecosystems.


Core Requirements

  • 4–7+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, System Analyst, or similar role.
  • Strong ability to translate business processes into structured workflows and logic.
  • Hands-on experience with low-code/no-code tools (e.g., Zapier, Make, Airtable, Retool, or similar platforms).
  • Experience working with AI tools (LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI automation platforms).
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and own end-to-end solution delivery.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)
  • Technical / AI-Related
  • Experience designing multi-step prompts or AI workflows (not just single prompts).
  • Understanding of how LLMs work and how to structure prompts for reliable outputs.
  • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, and automation tools is a plus.
  • Basic programming knowledge is helpful but not required.
  • Soft Skills
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work with non-technical stakeholders.
  • Business-oriented mindset with a focus on practical outcomes.
  • Curiosity and willingness to experiment with new AI tools and approaches.
  • Ability to operate in an ambiguous, fast-evolving environment.
  • Domain Experience
  • Experience in digital media, advertising tech, or media planning.


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Proven ability to design, build, and operate sophisticated AI agents.
  • Expertise in advanced prompt engineering, including multi-step prompting, few-shot learning, and optimizing for specific model outputs.
  • Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.
  • Ability to produce and manage, work autonomously, and take initiative.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and roles.
  • Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Full-Stack Engineer
description:
About Us

Evvolve & Partners is a financial advisory firm operating across North America, Europe, and the Middle East. We are building internal tools and custom platforms that power how our team operates day to day. We move fast, we build things that get used, and we care deeply about the quality of what we ship. We are looking for a Full-Stack Engineer to join us remotely and take full ownership of the technical side of our internal stack.


What you will be working on

  • Designing and building internal tools and custom platforms from the ground up
  • Full-stack development across frontend interfaces, backend services, and database architecture
  • Implementing complex business logic and automation workflows across our systems
  • Integrating multiple internal and external APIs into a cohesive, reliable stack
  • Owning the reliability of what you ship — including maintenance, debugging, and continuous improvement
  • Working closely with leadership to translate operational needs into clean technical solutions

  • Solid backend experience — server-side logic, relational and non-relational databases, data pipelines
  • Deep experience with APIs, webhooks, and multi-system integrations
  • Hands-on experience integrating LLMs or AI agents into real production workflows
  • Experience with CRM systems and workflow automation at scale
  • Proven background building internal tooling for fast-moving, operational teams
  • Systems thinker — you consider edge cases, failure modes, and data integrity before they become problems
  • Comfortable working autonomously in an async-first environment
  • Able to show us real work — a live product, a GitHub, or something tangible


What we offer

  • Fully remote position
  • Competitive compensation based on experience
  • Direct collaboration with the founding team
  • Ownership over meaningful, high-impact technical work

title: Digital Business Analyst
description:
Digital Business Analyst – Shape the Future of Energy Reporting & Operations!


We are recruiting on behalf of a global energy services organisation operating across Gas & Power Services. This programme sits at the heart of operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and customer transparency - replacing fragmented, manual reporting with a scalable digital reporting solution across complex industrial assets.


You’ll join a long-term, high-impact transformation programme focused on power plant operations, Operations & Maintenance (O&M), and performance reporting. This is a discovery-heavy role with real ownership, working directly with senior stakeholders to define what the product should be, before it’s built.


As a Digital Business Analyst, you’ll lead domain discovery, define product capabilities, and act as the bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams to turn complex operational needs into a clear, scalable digital solution.


Your Role:

You’ll be the bridge between operations, data, and delivery. This is a senior, hands-on role where you’ll rapidly onboard into the Gas & Power Services domain, lead structured discovery, and shape a digital reporting product from the ground up - with ownership through to delivery and value realisation.


What You’ll Do:

  • Lead structured interviews and workshops with domain heads and SMEs to capture current-state (“as-is”) processes, data flows, and pain points
  • Translate business needs into clear product capabilities, outcomes, and success measures
  • Define reporting requirements, data inputs, ownership models, and KPIs across performance, efficiency, safety, environmental, and financial metrics
  • Balance standardisation and configurability across plants, equipment types, and markets
  • Create and maintain product vision, roadmap, capability maps, and a prioritised backlog
  • Define the end-to-end data and reporting strategy - from data collection and validation through to dashboards and customer-facing outputs
  • Work closely with Solution Architects to ensure technical feasibility, scalability, and long-term sustainability
  • Act as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams, driving clarity and momentum
  • Lead demos, clarify scope boundaries, and align expectations on custom vs configurable functionality
  • Support planning, estimation, sequencing, and governance across a multi-phase programme
  • Track progress against milestones and help define what success looks like by September 2026


What You Bring:

  • Proven ability to lead discovery independently and bring structure to ambiguous environments
  • Experience working on data-driven products, reporting systems, or analytics platforms
  • Experience with international, enterprise environments
  • Excellent stakeholder management and facilitation skills across senior, operational, and technical audiences
  • Confidence translating complex operational domains into clear, actionable requirements
  • Exposure to energy, utilities, power generation, or industrial operations is highly desirable
  • Familiarity with operational KPIs, asset performance management, and HSE reporting is a strong plus
  • Experience working with dashboards, BI tools, or custom reporting solutions

  • A strong community of senior engineers, curated content, and role alerts

title: Forensic Manager
description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.


Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.


Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.


In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.


To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.


While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.

title: Marketing AI Agent Builder
description:
Role Overview:

As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. title: Digital Business Analyst
description:
Digital Business Analyst – Shape the Future of Energy Reporting & Operations!


We are recruiting on behalf of a global energy services organisation operating across Gas & Power Services. This programme sits at the heart of operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and customer transparency - replacing fragmented, manual reporting with a scalable digital reporting solution across complex industrial assets.


You’ll join a long-term, high-impact transformation programme focused on power plant operations, Operations & Maintenance (O&M), and performance reporting. This is a discovery-heavy role with real ownership, working directly with senior stakeholders to define what the product should be, before it’s built.


As a Digital Business Analyst, you’ll lead domain discovery, define product capabilities, and act as the bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams to turn complex operational needs into a clear, scalable digital solution.


Your Role:

You’ll be the bridge between operations, data, and delivery. This is a senior, hands-on role where you’ll rapidly onboard into the Gas & Power Services domain, lead structured discovery, and shape a digital reporting product from the ground up - with ownership through to delivery and value realisation.


What You’ll Do:

  • Lead structured interviews and workshops with domain heads and SMEs to capture current-state (“as-is”) processes, data flows, and pain points
  • Translate business needs into clear product capabilities, outcomes, and success measures
  • Define reporting requirements, data inputs, ownership models, and KPIs across performance, efficiency, safety, environmental, and financial metrics
  • Balance standardisation and configurability across plants, equipment types, and markets
  • Create and maintain product vision, roadmap, capability maps, and a prioritised backlog
  • Define the end-to-end data and reporting strategy - from data collection and validation through to dashboards and customer-facing outputs
  • Work closely with Solution Architects to ensure technical feasibility, scalability, and long-term sustainability
  • Act as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams, driving clarity and momentum
  • Lead demos, clarify scope boundaries, and align expectations on custom vs configurable functionality
  • Support planning, estimation, sequencing, and governance across a multi-phase programme
  • Track progress against milestones and help define what success looks like by September 2026


What You Bring:

  • Proven ability to lead discovery independently and bring structure to ambiguous environments
  • Experience working on data-driven products, reporting systems, or analytics platforms
  • Experience with international, enterprise environments
  • Excellent stakeholder management and facilitation skills across senior, operational, and technical audiences
  • Confidence translating complex operational domains into clear, actionable requirements
  • Exposure to energy, utilities, power generation, or industrial operations is highly desirable
  • Familiarity with operational KPIs, asset performance management, and HSE reporting is a strong plus
  • Experience working with dashboards, BI tools, or custom reporting solutions


Why Join the Remobi community:

  • Fully remote B2B / freelance contracts
  • Access to high-impact roles across AI, FinTech, and modern infrastructure
  • A strong community of senior engineers, curated content, and role alerts
  • Work with fast-scaling companies where your impact is visible and valued


Apply today:

If you’re a Digital Business Analyst who thrives in discovery, enjoys shaping products from complex operational environments, and wants to deliver measurable business value in the energy sector - we’d love to hear from you.

description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.


Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.


Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.


In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.


To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.


While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.

title: Digital Business Analyst
description:
Digital Business Analyst – Shape the Future of Energy Reporting & Operations!


We are recruiting on behalf of a global energy services organisation operating across Gas & Power Services. This programme sits at the heart of operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and customer transparency - replacing fragmented, manual reporting with a scalable digital reporting solution across complex industrial assets.


You’ll join a long-term, high-impact transformation programme focused on power plant operations, Operations & Maintenance (O&M), and performance reporting. This is a discovery-heavy role with real ownership, working directly with senior stakeholders to define what the product should be, before it’s built.


As a Digital Business Analyst, you’ll lead domain discovery, define product capabilities, and act as the bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams to turn complex operational needs into a clear, scalable digital solution.


Your Role:

You’ll be the bridge between operations, data, and delivery. This is a senior, hands-on role where you’ll rapidly onboard into the Gas & Power Services domain, lead structured discovery, and shape a digital reporting product from the ground up - with ownership through to delivery and value realisation.


What You’ll Do:

  • Lead structured interviews and workshops with domain heads and SMEs to capture current-state (“as-is”) processes, data flows, and pain points
  • Translate business needs into clear product capabilities, outcomes, and success measures
  • Define reporting requirements, data inputs, ownership models, and KPIs across performance, efficiency, safety, environmental, and financial metrics
  • Balance standardisation and configurability across plants, equipment types, and markets
  • Create and maintain product vision, roadmap, capability maps, and a prioritised backlog
  • Define the end-to-end data and reporting strategy - from data collection and validation through to dashboards and customer-facing outputs
  • Work closely with Solution Architects to ensure technical feasibility, scalability, and long-term sustainability
  • Act as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams, driving clarity and momentum
  • Lead demos, clarify scope boundaries, and align expectations on custom vs configurable functionality
  • Support planning, estimation, sequencing, and governance across a multi-phase programme
  • Track progress against milestones and help define what success looks like by September 2026


What You Bring:

  • Proven ability to lead discovery independently and bring structure to ambiguous environments
  • Experience working on data-driven products, reporting systems, or analytics platforms
  • Experience with international, enterprise environments
  • Excellent stakeholder management and facilitation skills across senior, operational, and technical audiences
  • Confidence translating complex operational domains into clear, actionable requirements
  • Exposure to energy, utilities, power generation, or industrial operations is highly desirable
  • Familiarity with operational KPIs, asset performance management, and HSE reporting is a strong plus
  • Experience working with dashboards, BI tools, or custom reporting solutions


Why Join the Remobi community:

  • Fully remote B2B / freelance contracts
  • Access to high-impact roles across AI, FinTech, and modern infrastructure
  • A strong community of senior engineers, curated content, and role alerts
  • Work with fast-scaling companies where your impact is visible and valued


Apply today:

If you’re a Digital Business Analyst who thrives in discovery, enjoys shaping products from complex operational environments, and wants to deliver measurable business value in the energy sector - we’d love to hear from you.

title: Marketing AI Agent Builder
description:
Role Overview:

As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.

Core Responsibilities:

• Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.

• Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.

• Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.

• Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.

• System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including HubSpot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.

Qualifications & Skills:

• Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market SaaS revenue engine.

• AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude CoWork, CodeX)

• Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI).

• Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.

• Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company’s internal knowledge base.

• Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

title: Forensic Manager
description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.


Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.


Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.


In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.


To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.


While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.

title: Marketing AI Agent Builder
description:

As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. title: Quality Assurence
description:

Buscamos profissionais para atuação em qualidade ponta a ponta , com foco em validação funcional, geração de evidências e rastreabilidade das entregas em um ecossistema com microserviços, integrações e múltiplos meios de pagamento .


Essa posição tem foco funcional, porém exige conhecimento obrigatório em JavaScript e Playwright , para apoiar validações técnicas, ajustes de fluxo e interpretações de respostas de APIs quando necessário.


Você fará parte de um time orientado à excelência em qualidade, atuando de forma próxima aos times de desenvolvimento, produto e operações.


Responsabilidades

  • Planejar, executar e evidenciar testes funcionais ponta a ponta.
  • Criar e manter cenários e casos de teste com rastreabilidade no Jira/Xray , utilizando BDD com Gherkin (uso obrigatório) .
  • Executar testes de regressão, testes exploratórios e suporte a UAT/homologação.
  • Validar integrações e fluxos críticos envolvendo APIs, microserviços, mensageria (SQS), ERP e meios de pagamento (Pix, Boleto e Cartão) .
  • Acompanhar incidentes/bugs, apoiar priorização e realizar retestes.
  • Garantir rastreabilidade entre requisito ↔ teste ↔ evidência ↔ defeito .
  • Implementar testes e ajustes utilizando Playwright .
  • Apoiar validações técnicas com JavaScript (ex.: lógica de validação, estruturação de payloads, análise de respostas de APIs, interpretação de objetos JSON e pequenos scripts de apoio).


Requisitos Obrigatórios


  • Experiência com testes funcionais e processos de qualidade em ambientes ágeis.
  • Vivência com sistemas distribuídos e integrações (APIs/microserviços).
  • Experiência com validação de APIs via Postman ou Insomnia .
  • Experiência com Jira e Xray .
  • Uso obrigatório de BDD com Gherkin para criação e manutenção de cenários.
  • Boa escrita de cenários, critérios de aceite e documentação de evidências.
  • Experiência com testes de regressão e priorização de cenários críticos.
  • Conhecimento obrigatório em JavaScript (não atuará como QE, mas precisa interpretar, ajustar e criar pequenos trechos de código).
  • Experiência sólida com Playwright (locators, interações, assertions, waits, screenshots e vídeos).
  • Experiência com CI/CD e execução de testes em pipelines (ex.: Jenkins) .
  • Conhecimento em Docker e ambientes conteinerizados.


Diferenciais


  • Noções de observabilidade (Dynatrace, Loki).
  • Experiência com jornadas de Checkout e Pagamentos (Pix, boleto, cartão) .
  • Noções de segurança/controles (ex.: PCI) aplicados a testes.
  • Conhecimento básico em AWS ou ambientes cloud (multi-account) .


Sobre a OSF Digital


A OSF Digital tem orgulho de ser uma empresa que oferece oportunidades iguais, onde você pode ser você mesmo no trabalho. Junte-se a uma comunidade inclusiva e apaixonada de profissionais que ajudam a promover a transformação digital para empresas ao redor do mundo.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Graphic Designer


Our Client is hiring a designer to support a high-output marketing team. This is not a brand-from-scratch role. The design system exists, and the job is to execute consistently, extend it intelligently, and keep things moving without hand-holding.


You’ll work directly with Marketing, with guidance from the Creative Director. Most of what you produce will show up in demand gen campaigns, event programs, and product marketing. It needs to look sharp, ship fast, and hold up across channels.


What you’ll do

  • You’ll be responsible for a wide range of design work tied directly to pipeline-driving campaigns
  • Create graphics for social, paid campaigns, email, and web
  • Design and iterate on landing pages in Webflow
  • Produce visual assets for webinars, virtual events, and campaigns
  • Design print collateral and occasional physical assets (including SWAG)
  • Create GIFs, motion elements, and lightweight animations
  • Edit video for social distribution and website use
  • Support ongoing campaign launches with fast-turn creative
  • This is a volume role, and you’ll be expected to make good decisions quickly and maintain quality under pace.


What matters in this role

  • You can operate inside an existing brand system without needing constant direction
  • You understand how design actually shows up in B2B marketing, not just how it looks in a portfolio
  • You’re comfortable moving between formats. Static, motion, web, video. No one is handing off perfect briefs every time
  • You have strong judgment about what’s “good enough to ship” vs what needs refinement
  • You can manage your own workflow and keep projects moving without bottlenecks


Requirements

  • 4+ years in a design role, ideally supporting marketing or growth teams
  • Strong portfolio that shows real campaign work, not just one-off visuals
  • Experience designing in Webflow (not just Figma concepts)
  • Experience with motion design and basic animation (GIFs, short-form video)
  • Video editing experience for social and web content
  • Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite


Context for the work

Our client sells to B2B marketing teams running webinars and virtual events as part of pipeline generation. That means the creative you produce will be tied directly to:

  • Driving registrations and product demos
  • Increasing engagement
  • Supporting sales follow-up
  • Reinforcing brand credibility with senior marketing leaders

The output needs to feel polished, but it has to perform, not just look good.


What this is not

  • Not a pure brand exploration role
  • Not a pixel-perfect, weeks-per-project environment
  • Not isolated design work handed over a wall


You’ll be in the middle of campaigns, working closely with marketers who are moving fast and expect the same from you.


If that sounds like your kind of environment, this will be a good fit.

title: Desenvolvedor Salesforce Sênior
description:

O que você vai fazer no dia a dia?

  • Desenvolver e apoiar atividades de modelagem de dados no ambiente Salesforce, incluindo criação de objetos, campos e processos automatizados (flows, workflows, validation rules, process builders);

  • Participar do processo de code review, garantindo qualidade e consistência do código;
  • Atuar com conhecimentos específicos da plataforma Salesforce, alinhado aos princípios de qualidade do CoE (Centro Operacional de Excelência em Salesforce) e políticas de governança;
  • Participar das cerimônias ágeis com o time (Daily, Review e Planning), aplicando metodologia ágil (SCRUM) no fluxo de trabalho.


O que esperamos de você?


Conhecimentos técnicos obrigatórios:

  • Requerida experiência de 2 anos com criação e manutenção de Apex, incluindo Triggers, Apex Batches, Schedulers, Test Classes, DataFactory, bem como com padrões de projeto (Service, Helper, TriggerHandler, Wrapper) e boas práticas.
  • Requerida experiência de 2 anos com Lightning Web Components, incluindo desenvolvimento e manutenção de componentes.
  • Requerida experiência de 2 anos com ferramentas declarativas, como Process Builder, Salesforce Flow, regras de validação, processos de aprovação, fluxos, gatilhos de fluxo e alertas de e-mail.
  • Requerida experiência de 2 anos com configuração de segurança e administração, abrangendo controle de segurança, criação de layouts, tipos de registros, perfis, painéis, relatórios, usuários, funções, grupos, filas, permission sets e permission sets groups, sempre seguindo boas práticas.
  • Requerida experiência de 2 anos com desenvolvimento end-to-end, incluindo levantamento de necessidades, implantação, implementação, testes e homologação.
  • Requerida experiência de 2 anos com Sales Cloud ou Service Cloud.
  • Requerida experiência com data modeling e data management no ambiente Salesforce.
  • Requerida experiência com ordem de execução de Triggers (Triggers and Orders of Execution).
  • Requerida experiência com debug logs e Developer Console.
  • Requerida experiência com Apex Testing.
  • Requerida experiência com integrações e desenvolvimento em Apex e .NET Basics.
  • Requerida experiência com Platform Development basics.
  • Requerida experiência com Lightning Experience Development.
  • Requerida experiência com alguma ferramenta de CI/CD (ex.: Flosum, Git).


Diferenciais que podem te destacar:

  • Ensino superior em Administração, Engenharia de sistemas ou Tecnologia da Informação;
  • Certificação Salesforce de Administrador/ Desenvolvedor/ Platform App Builder I;
  • Experiência com Salesforce e Salesforce Marketing Cloud;
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Lean, Kanban, SAFe etc.);
  • Experiência com indicadores de CRM;
  • Experiência com modelo arquitetural REST/SOAP;
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Experiência com o mercado Segurador, Previdenciário e/ou Financeiro.


Habilidades comportamentais que valorizamos:

  • Trabalho em equipe e colaboração;
  • Comprometimento e engajamento;
  • Comunicação eficaz e organização;
  • Disciplina e foco;
  • Raciocínio lógico e resolução de problemas;
  • Proatividade e aprendizado contínuo.

title: Principal Recruiter
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Principal Recruiter based in Latin America with 5+ years of experience in full-cycle recruiting and proven leadership capabilities. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of recruiters while owning end-to-end talent delivery strategy and execution across multiple roles.


You will partner closely with Sourcing, Client Success, and leadership to deliver high-quality talent, improve recruiting performance, and scale talent operations. This is a hands-on leadership role that combines execution, strategy, and team development.



Responsibilities



Lead & Develop the Recruiting Team

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of recruiters
  • Set clear performance expectations and talent quality standards
  • Provide structured feedback, training, and mentorship
  • Foster a high-performance, accountable, and collaborative team culture
  • Conduct regular 1:1s and support career growth of team members


Own Full-Cycle Recruiting Execution

  • Manage end-to-end recruiting processes from intake to offer
  • Screen, interview, and evaluate candidates for technical and non-technical roles
  • Ensure a high-quality candidate experience throughout the process
  • Partner with sourcing to ensure strong pipeline conversion
  • Oversee offer process and ensure smooth handoff to onboarding

Drive Recruiting Strategy & Client Partnership

  • Lead role intake and align on requirements with stakeholders
  • Translate business needs into structured recruiting strategies
  • Partner with Client Success and Resource Managers to meet talent delivery goals
  • Anticipate challenges and adjust strategies proactively
  • Ensure alignment between client expectations and recruiting execution


Elevate Candidate Evaluation & Talent Quality

  • Define and refine candidate assessment frameworks
  • Implement and oversee technical testing and evaluation processes
  • Ensure consistent and objective candidate selection across roles
  • Maintain high standards for candidate quality and role fit


Drive Operational Excellence

  • Improve recruiting workflows, processes, and documentation
  • Ensure consistency, speed, and quality across talent pipelines
  • Identify bottlenecks and implement process improvements
  • Manage referral programs and internal recruiting initiatives


Leverage Data & Continuous Improvement

  • Track and analyze recruiting metrics (e.g., time to fill, conversion rates)
  • Use data to improve talent delivery outcomes and team performance
  • Identify trends and opportunities for optimization
  • Continuously improve recruiting strategies, tools, and practices



Required Experience



  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in full-cycle recruiting and at least 3+ in a leadership position
  • Experience leading or mentoring recruiters
  • Strong interviewing and candidate evaluation skills
  • Experience managing multiple roles and stakeholders simultaneously
  • Ability to translate business needs into effective talent strategies
  • Familiarity with ATS platforms and recruiting tools
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to operate in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively


Desired Experience



  • Experience recruiting for technical roles
  • Experience working with North American clients or companies
  • Experience in agency, consulting, or nearshore/offshore recruiting environments
  • Exposure to recruiting analytics, reporting, or process optimization
  • Experience in growth-stage or startup environments


Additional Information



  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let’s learn from them. Be transparent!

title: Cloud Systems Engineer/DevOps
description:
About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Role Overview

We are seeking an expert-level, highly skilled Cloud Systems Engineer (DevOps) to serve as a GCP Specialist and technical builder for our Google Cloud ecosystem. This role requires more than administration; you must be capable of building architectural change, adjusting systems, and driving modernization efforts. You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of our GCP infrastructure, from complex networking to proactive cost optimization and resource scaling. A key responsibility is leading and running large-scale cloud migration projects, specifically from AWS to GCP.


The ideal candidate ensures our Compute Engine environment is lean, fast, and resilient while maintaining secure connectivity using both native and third-party VPN solutions.

The role’s primary focus demands deep GCP expertise, but candidates must also possess significant experience with AWS for successful migration

strategy.


Key Responsibilities

  • Infrastructure & Networking: Configure and maintain robust networking architectures, including Cloud DNS and Cloud NAT.
  • Linux System Administration: Manage and maintain the operating system environment on Compute Engine instances, including patching, configuration management, user account management, and troubleshooting core system issues.
  • VPN Management: Build and manage secure tunnels using Cloud VPN , pfSense virtual appliances, and CloudConnexa (OpenVPN) for flexible remote access.
  • Performance Monitoring: Utilize Google Cloud Operations Suite to monitor Compute Engine health. Identify bottlenecks and tune instances for peak performance.
  • Resource Management: Oversee persistent disks, snapshots, and storage buckets. Ensure high availability while purging unused resources to maintain environment hygiene.
  • Cost Optimization: Actively monitor billing dashboards, implement committed use discounts (CUDs), and right-size underutilized instances to maintain a lean budget.
  • Database Oversight: Provide support for PostgreSQL and Oracle environments, ensuring seamless integration and performance within the GCP ecosystem.
  • Security & Compliance : Enforce IAM roles and security best practices to protect the project perimeter


Required Qualifications

  • Certification: Active Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer certification.
  • Containerization Mastery: Strong expertise with Docker for containerizing applications, managing images, and troubleshooting container runtimes.
  • Scripting Mastery: High proficiency in Python or Bash for automating routine infrastructure tasks, reporting, and task scheduling.
  • Networking Expertise: Hands-on experience managing network routing, firewall rules, and site-to-site VPNs using pfSense and CloudConnexa.
  • Cloud Migration & Project Leadership: Proven experience leading and running application and data migrations from AWS to GCP. This includes the capability to own the end-to-end migration project life cycle and drive solutions.
  • Compute Engine Mastery: Deep understanding of VM lifecycles, custom machine types, and auto-scaling.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced English level (B2–C1 or higher)


Nice-to-Have

  • PostgreSQL Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with configuration, optimization, and query tuning.
  • Oracle Expertise: Experience managing or migrating Oracle database environments.
  • Data & Analytics: Familiarity with BigQuery.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

description:
Hello from RE Partners!


Who We Are: We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.

The 3 G’s of RE:

“Get Shit Done.”

“Get Over Shit.”

“Give a Shit.”


DevOps Engineer


We are looking for a DevOps Engineer with basic Golang skills to support a team focused on improving development processes and the product. In this role, you will work closely with a Staff Engineer building with a focus on designing, migrating, implementing, and maintaining the infrastructure and cloud environments that enable these systems to operate reliably and at scale.


Your work will involve containerized services, AWS Lambda, Terraform-managed infrastructure, and secure data transfer between AWS accounts , with a strong emphasis on scalability, security, and operational excellence.


You will collaborate with engineering, product, and operational teams, while also coordinating technical requirements with the vendor. Strong communication skills are important, as you’ll often act as the bridge between the team and other internal teams, ensuring infrastructure and systems are aligned with internal standards and best practices.



What we’re looking for:


● Strong AWS and DevOps experience (infrastructure, deployments, operations, observability)


● Solid experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform preferred)


● Experience with containerized environments (Docker, ECS/EKS, etc.)


● Hands-on experience with AWS services such as Lambda and related cloud tooling


● Golang and Bash skills for scripting, automation, and backend support


● Ability to work independently while collaborating with multiple stakeholders

This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy working towards engineering excellence and helping the team excel. You will collaborate across infrastructure and development teams to deliver impactful solutions.

title: Analista de Processos - PCM

Você está em uma jornada para ingressar em uma empresa emocionante e fazer parte de nossa história de sucesso. Aqui vamos equipá-lo com o know-how e a experiência que definirão seu crescimento. Nesta função em que você está prestes a embarcar, você deve cumprir as seguintes responsabilidades:

title: Brazil Senior Condition Intelligence (CI & PM)
description:
Company Description

Dingo Software is the global leader in predictive maintenance software for the mining industry, serving some of the world’s largest mining companies. We are best known for Driving efficiency, longevity and reliability for machines that matter. With 30+ years of asset health data, we're scaling rapidly under Riverside Company ownership to capture significant market opportunities.

Following recent investment from The Riverside Company, Dingo is executing an ambitious growth strategy. We're building world-class commercial capabilities to support this growth journey.


Role Description

As a Condition Intelligence (CI) Specialist at Dingo, you will be at the heart of delivering data-driven insights that help our clients across the Americas protect their most critical assets. Your mission is to transform fluid, sensor, and digital inspection data into clear, actionable recommendations that prevent mobile and fixed-plant breakdowns, extend component life, and eliminate unplanned downtime.

In this pivotal role, you will collaborate closely within then Dingo Technical Services team to monitor asset health remotely, assess component-level risk, and guide operational decisions that directly impact productivity, safety, and cost efficiency. You will be instrumental in harnessing Dingo’s advanced analytics and AI-driven capabilities to proactively engage client to identify risks before they escalate, ensuring consistently measurable results.

With a primary focus on our rapidly growing North and South American customer base, you will combine technical expertise with strong communication skills to deliver timely, trusted advice, strengthening long-term partnerships. In a mining sector increasingly focused on efficiency, sustainability, and predictive maintenance, your work will be a key driver in cementing Dingo’s reputation as the leader in asset health intelligence.


Condition Data Analysis & Diagnostics – Review and interpret condition management data from both mobile and fixed plant assets to diagnose component-level risks. Apply domain expertise to determine root causes, assess severity, and prioritize corrective actions based on operational impact, safety, and mission criticality.

Rules-Based Analytics Development – Create and refine rules-based analytics to enable swift detection of emerging issues. Ensure diagnostic models and alert parameters support early intervention, reducing downtime and extending component life.

Technical Support & Collaboration – Provide expert guidance to Dingo teams on component health assessments, lubrication strategies, and condition management best practices. Act as a trusted technical resource for troubleshooting and advanced diagnostics.

Customer Communication & Maintenance Recommendations – Follow up on flagged components or lubricant issues, translating complex technical data into clear, actionable maintenance recommendations for customers. Ensure communications are timely, accurate, and aligned with customer priorities.

Quality Observation Reviews – Deliver high-quality, daily observation reviews and actionable insights, consistently applying safety-first principles and considering operational mission criticality.

Data Accuracy & System Integrity – Monitor the condition management software database to ensure data accuracy, resolve discrepancies, and maintain the integrity of condition records.

Lubricated Component Health Assessment – Evaluate the condition of lubricated components to identify opportunities for extending asset life through on-condition maintenance changes.

Customer Engagement & Follow-Up – Organize and lead remote Condition Management follow-up meetings with customers and internal teams to confirm satisfaction, address concerns, and reinforce positive engagement experiences.

Diagnostic Tools & Guideline Development – Assist in developing structured diagnostic guidelines, contamination troubleshooting processes, and detailed repair procedures to support consistent, high-quality component health management.


Qualifications

Experience – Minimum of five (5) years’ experience in heavy industrial equipment maintenance within industrial or mining environments; OR a Mechanical or Mining Engineering degree with at least two (2) years of relevant experience. Hands-on background as a shop or field mechanic for industrial mining equipment is highly desirable.

Industry Knowledge – Strong familiarity with mining and industrial maintenance principles, including mechanical systems, equipment design, and repair processes.

Lubrication & Condition Monitoring Expertise – In-depth understanding of lubrication applications, maintenance principles, familiarity in onboard machine telemetry and/or OEM condition monitoring reporting systems, and the use of condition monitoring technologies and tools to inform proactive maintenance strategies.

Technical Proficiency – Proven ability to use data and factual analysis to troubleshoot issues, solve problems, and make informed operational decisions.

Linguistic Proficiency – Fluency in English is essential for clear and effective communication with customers and internal teams. A high degree of proficiency in Spanish or French is a strong advantage for engaging with a broader range of stakeholders.

Communication & Leadership – Excellent verbal and written communication skills, coupled with strong information management capabilities. Demonstrated ability to lead interactions with both internal teams and external customers, building trust and alignment.

title: Virtual Assistant Team Manager - Independent Contractor
description:
Job description: Talent Manager(Independent Contractor)

**Must send resume in English**



Overview:

The Talent Manager is a critical, detail-driven role responsible for both managing relationships with our independent contractor virtual assistants and ensuring the accurate execution of ongoing administrative and operational tasks that support those relationships. This position plays a key role in Virtual Assistant retention by combining strong interpersonal skills with disciplined documentation, organization, and follow-through. Success in this role requires the ability to build trust, actively listen, and proactively resolve issues—while simultaneously maintaining precise records, managing time tracking, and supporting internal systems and processes that keep the business running smoothly.


Key Responsibilities:


Relationship Management

  • Conduct weekly check-in meetings with each assigned Virtual Assistant while accurately documenting discussions, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Build and maintain professional, trust-based relationships with Virtual Assistants while encouraging open, honest dialogue.
  • Accurately document meeting notes, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Keep Virtual Assistants accountable for meetings, calls, time submission, and other requests or requirements through clear tracking and follow-up.
  • Identify, document, and escalate potential issues or concerns to the leadership team with appropriate context and supporting notes.
  • Create a supportive and open communication environment with VAs, clients, and management.
  • Detect subtle communication cues and potential challenges, log observations, and alert management when appropriate.



Administrative

  • Manage the full onboarding process for new Virtual Assistants, ensuring all documentation, checklists, and meetings are completed accurately and on time.
  • Manage the full onboarding process for new clients, ensuring all documentation, meetings, and follow-ups are completed accurately and on time.
  • Organize, maintain, and manage shared drives and digital files, ensuring proper document categorization, version control, and audit-ready internal documentation.
  • Perform basic website updates such as posting content or minor edits.
  • Reformat documents to ensure clarity, consistency, and professional presentation.
  • Compile reports, summaries, and data tracking related to VA performance, feedback, and engagement.
  • Maintain accurate and organized records of meetings, feedback, action items, and resolutions.
  • Oversee timesheet management, including tracking submissions, following up on missing or incorrect entries, and inputting approved hours into systems for payment processing


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in HR, counseling, or relationship management
  • Proven ability to build quick trust and extract meaningful information
  • Exceptional English verbal and written communication skills
  • Advanced typing speed (minimum 70 WPM with high accuracy)
  • Proven ability to multitask (conversing while documenting)


Technical Requirements:

  • Fully remote position
  • High-speed, stable internet connection
  • Professional-grade webcam
  • High-quality speakerphone or headset
  • Modern computer with reliable performance
  • Proficiency with video conferencing tools and spreadsheet software


Personal Attributes:

  • Empathetic and active listener
  • Ability to create a non-threatening, supportive conversation environment
  • Quick thinking and adaptable communication style
  • Patient and persistent in building relationships
  • Skilled at drawing out information from reserved individuals



Note: This is an independent contractor position. Candidates must provide their own equipment and manage their own taxes and benefits.

title: Staff Data Platform Engineer
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?

  • Buscar inspiração no mercado para trazer novas ideias que possam ser utilizadas para melhorar a plataforma de dados;
  • Atuar ativamente na detecção e na solução de problemas, oportunidades e melhorias relacionados à disciplina de dados na tecnologia;

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou área relacionada;
  • Python;
  • SQL;
  • Conceitos de administração de banco de dados;
  • Conceitos de DW;
  • Shell;
  • Alguma ferramenta/linguagem de IaC: terraform, ansible, puppet;
  • Conceitos de infraestrutura (rede, disco, cpu...);
  • Proficiência com containers (docker, kubernetes);
  • Conceitos de engenharia de software (protocolos de API, SoC, SOLID e etc);
  • Conceitos de sistemas com uso intensivo de dados: lakehouse, data lake, DW MPP;
  • Proficiência com ferramentas de processamento em streaming: kafka, spark, flink;
  • Conceitos de streaming de dados: hopping, session, tumbling;
  • Proficiência com bancos nosql: mongo, cassandra (scyllaDB), druid
  • Conceitos de arquiteturas de sistemas distribuidos: ring, master/worker;
  • Conceitos de machine learning: treino, serving, feature, reinforcement learning;
  • Proficiência com infraestrutura em cloud.

title: DBA de Oracle
description:
DBA Oracle Pleno


Prime DB Solutions | Remoto | PJ | Período Noturno (18h às 00h)


Sobre a Prime DB Solutions


A Prime DB Solutions é uma consultoria especializada em dados, banco de dados, cloud e infraestrutura , com mais de 14 anos de atuação no mercado.


Reconhecida pela Oracle como uma das principais referências em Oracle Cloud na América Latina por três anos consecutivos , também somos Oracle Partner e Microsoft Partner , atuando em projetos de missão crítica para empresas de diversos portes.


Nosso modelo de atuação é consultivo e altamente técnico , com forte proximidade com clientes e foco em entrega de valor. Aqui, você trabalhará diretamente com ambientes reais e desafiadores, interagindo com times técnicos e áreas de negócio.


Modelo de Trabalho

  • Contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ)
  • Formato: 100% remoto
  • Horário: 18h às 00h (turno noturno)
  • Equipamento: Necessário possuir notebook próprio adequado para execução das atividades


Sobre a Oportunidade


Buscamos um(a) DBA Oracle Pleno que seja proativo e disciplinado para atuar em atendimentos de chamados de sustentação de ambientes críticos e de alta complexidade , com foco em monitoramento e resolução de problemas no período noturno.


O profissional terá atuação direta com clientes, participando de incidentes, análises de performance e melhoria contínua dos ambientes.


Responsabilidades


  • Atuar no atendimento de incidentes e problemas em ambientes Oracle, garantindo a continuidade dos serviços
  • Monitorar ambientes com ferramentas como Zabbix , atuando de forma preventiva
  • Executar rotinas de administração: backup, restore, manutenção e análise de ambientes
  • Realizar troubleshooting de performance (queries, waits, locks e consumo de recursos)
  • Analisar e otimizar planos de execução
  • Administrar ambientes Standby standard e Data Guard (monitoramento, GAP, switchover e failover)
  • Executar atividades de manutenção: reorganização de objetos, gestão de tablespaces e storage
  • Apoiar projetos de migração, upgrade e implantação
  • Garantir segurança e integridade dos dados (backup, criptografia, acesso)
  • Atuar em salas de crise , conduzindo resolução de incidentes críticos
  • Documentar procedimentos e atividades realizadas


Requisitos Obrigatórios

Oracle Database

  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos como DBA Oracle
  • Atuação em suporte a ambientes produtivos (nível N2)
  • Experiência com monitoramento (Zabbix ou similar )
  • Administração de Oracle 11g, 12c e 19c (23ai/26ai será considerado diferencial)
  • Experiência com RMAN (backup e recovery completo e pontual)
  • Conhecimento em Data Guard (GAP, switchover, troubleshooting)
  • Experiência com ASM (criação e gestão de diskgroups)
  • Conhecimento em performance tuning (AWR, ASH, planos de execução, índices)
  • Administração de Linux (nível básico a intermediário)
  • Gestão de espaço (tablespaces, datafiles, crescimento e reorganização )
  • Instalação e configuração de ambientes Oracle (on-premises ou cloud como OCI/DBCS)
  • Noções de segurança (usuários, roles, Oracle Wallet, TDE básico)

Comunicação e Consultoria

  • Capacidade de conduzir reuniões técnicas (incidentes, GMUDs, alinhamentos)
  • Experiência em consultoria ou atendimento a múltiplos clientes simultaneamente


Formação

  • Ensino superior completo em:
  • Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia, Estatística ou áreas correlatas


Diferenciais

  • Certificações Oracle (OCA, OCP e OCI)
  • Experiência com outros bancos de dados: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB


Perfil Comportamental

  • Forte capacidade analítica e resolução de problemas complexos
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva (técnica e com negócio)
  • Organização para atuar com múltiplos clientes e demandas simultâneas
  • Postura consultiva, com foco em melhoria contínua e geração de valor

title: Lead Generation Specialist
description:
The pay for this role will be between USD 693 to 850/month, depending on experience.


About Us

Publicity For Good (PFG) is a US-based, female-founded public relations agency that partners with impact-driven, heart-centered leaders and purpose-driven CPG brands (Food & Beverage, Fashion, and Beauty). We are an all-female team dedicated to amplifying brands that make a difference through meaningful visibility and measurable growth. We operate in a fun, fast-paced environment where collaboration creates magic.


Role

This position is responsible for generating and nurturing qualified leads with the primary objective of booking sales calls. The Lead Generation Specialist will manage inbound and outbound lead channels, validate prospect interest, coordinate with the sales team, and maintain an organized pipeline across multiple platforms.


As a Lead Generation Specialist , you will monitor and respond to leads from various sources including Meta ads, Leadhype, Smartlead, and GoHighLevel (GHL). You will conduct call show audits, manage follow-up sequences, update pipeline statuses, and ensure seamless handoff of qualified prospects to the sales team. This role requires strong communication skills, exceptional organization, and the ability to work independently across multiple systems while maintaining high response rates and booking quality.


Responsibilities

  • Monitor and respond to new leads across all platforms (GHL, Leadhype, Smartlead, Meta ads).
  • Conduct daily call show audits and update show/no-show statuses in tracking systems.
  • Manage and update the Airtable Lead Gen dashboard with accurate lead data and metrics.
  • Qualify inbound leads and schedule sales calls with interested prospects.
  • Execute manual follow-ups for warm leads and re-engagement campaigns.
  • Review and respond to positive replies from Leadhype and Smartlead outreach campaigns.
  • Update lead tags, statuses, and ownership in GHL based on prospect engagement and stage.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management and ensure all conversations are properly categorized.
  • Coordinate reschedules for no-show prospects and maintain consistent follow-up cadence.
  • Process and segment new Meta ads leads into appropriate workflows.
  • Review notes from sales reps in GHL and take necessary follow-up actions.
  • Update sales team on lead status changes, show/no-show patterns, and booking confirmations.
  • Track daily lead generation metrics including new conversations, responses, and bookings.
  • Identify and flag low-quality leads or technical issues with lead sources.
  • Maintain organized conversation threads and ensure timely responses to all inquiries.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing teams to improve lead quality and conversion rates.
  • Test and optimize messaging templates across platforms to improve response rates.
  • Ensure all lead generation software and integrations function properly.


Results

  • Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales call booking targets.
  • Maintain high response rates across all lead channels (within 1-2 hours for new leads).
  • Deliver accurate and timely daily reports on lead generation activities and pipeline status.
  • Ensure qualified leads are properly nurtured and handed off to sales with complete context.
  • Identify trends in lead quality, response rates, and show/no-show patterns.
  • Maintain an organized and up-to-date pipeline with proper tagging and segmentation.
  • Support predictable sales pipeline through consistent lead flow and booking quality.
  • Reduce lead leakage by ensuring no prospect falls through the cracks.
  • Contribute to improved conversion rates through effective qualification and pre-call preparation.


Requirements

  • Prior experience in lead generation, sales development, or appointment setting of at least 2 years.
  • Strong written communication skills with ability to engage prospects effectively.
  • Experience with CRM platforms, especially GoHighLevel (GHL), or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with lead generation platforms such as Leadhype, Smartlead, or comparable systems.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple lead sources and prioritize high-value opportunities.
  • Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and time management skills.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Comfortable working with data, tracking metrics, and identifying performance patterns.
  • Experience with Airtable, Google Workspace, and project management tools preferred.
  • Strong technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn new platforms and systems.
  • Results-driven mindset with focus on meeting and exceeding KPIs.
  • Ability to handle high-volume communication while maintaining quality and personalization.
  • Professional, persistent, and positive attitude with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Discretion in handling sensitive prospect and client information.
  • Adaptability to changing priorities and willingness to optimize processes continuously.


The pay for this role will be between USD 693 to 850/month, depending on experience.

title: Data Engineer
description:
About FirstIgnite:

FirstIgnite builds best-in-class software that accelerates commercialization and innovation by connecting scientific research with industry partners. We support universities, national labs, and research hospitals worldwide with tools that simplify complex science and identify real partnership opportunities.


Role Overview:

The Data Engineer will lead the design, development, and maintenance of scalable data systems that integrate diverse datasets. This role includes deploying AI and machine learning solutions to enhance insights, manage complex data relationships, and drive actionable intelligence for FirstIgnite’s platform. You will mentor and manage a team of data engineers while working cross-functionally to innovate and deliver impactful AI-driven solutions.


Responsibilities :

  • Lead the architecture, development, and optimization of scalable data pipelines for patents, grants, clinical trials, publications, labs, and firmographic sources.
  • Build and maintain ETL workflows on AWS using Glue (PySpark), Lambda, S3, and RDS PostgreSQL.
  • Explore and implement complementary data storage solutions as needed.
  • Apply machine learning and LLM-based techniques to extract, structure, and enrich data at scale.
  • Ensure data integrity, security, accuracy, and governance across all systems.
  • Implement tools for data exploration, visualization, and actionable insights.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to drive AI-driven innovation.
  • Evaluate emerging AI/ML techniques and tools to enhance platform capabilities.
  • Maintain version control, CI/CD pipelines, and reproducible workflows for the data engineering team.


Requirements :

  • Strong programming expertise in Python, with experience building production data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS data services (Glue/PySpark, Lambda, S3, RDS PostgreSQL, SSM) or equivalent cloud data stacks.
  • Familiarity with RESTful and GraphQL APIs, ETL processes, and data integration strategies.
  • Understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI-enhanced data applications.
  • Strong analytical skills, including evaluating trade-offs of data ingestion and storage methods.
  • Leadership experience managing data engineering or AI teams in SaaS or tech environments.
  • Solid knowledge of version control (Git) and CI/CD practices.
  • Exposure to data science / ML libraries (Pandas, Scikit-learn, PyTorch) and managed ML platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI) is a plus.
  • Excellent problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills in cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and drive projects from conception to deployment.


Additional Qualifications:

  • Experience with web scraping at scale (Firecrawl or similar).
  • LLM-based data extraction and prompt engineering for structured output.
  • Data quality instrumentation and observability for pipelines.

title: Content Creator
description:
Localização:  Remoto

Tipo:  Freelance / Contrato

Remuneração:  R$350–R$450 por semana (de acordo com o nível) + bônus (com base em visualizações)

Período de teste:  2 semanas, pago R$250 / semana


Sobre o Pure

O Pure é um aplicativo de namoro global e ousado que está redefinindo a forma como as pessoas se conectam. Acreditamos que o namoro deve ser honesto, divertido e livre de julgamentos — um espaço para explorar confiança, química e autoexpressão.

Estamos construindo uma comunidade de criadores UGC para ajudar a contar essa história.


Sobre a Comunidade de Criadores UGC

Estamos procurando criadores de conteúdo para redes sociais para se juntarem à nossa Comunidade de Criadores UGC do Pure — um grupo que produz vídeos curtos (TikTok / Instagram) sobre temas como namoro, confiança, amor-próprio, entre outros.

Como criador, você terá a oportunidade de colaborar com o nosso time, desenvolver sua marca pessoal e ser pago para criar conteúdos autênticos e envolventes que desafiam a forma como as pessoas enxergam o namoro.


O que você vai fazer
  • Criar e postar 7 vídeos curtos por semana (TikTok / Instagram Reels / YouTube Shorts, etc.)
  • Desenvolver conteúdos inspirados em namoro, conexões e autoexpressão
  • Direcionar pessoas para o app
  • Participar de briefings criativos, tendências e campanhas
  • Receber feedback e orientação para melhorar sua performance
  • Colaborar com o time em ideias de storytelling e estratégias sociais


O que buscamos
  • Você deve estar baseado no Brasil e ser fluente em português
  • Paixão por storytelling, redes sociais e cultura contemporânea
  • Familiaridade com tendências do TikTok, formatos de Reels e conteúdo UGC
  • Boa presença em frente às câmeras e habilidades de edição
  • Consistência e capacidade de cumprir metas semanais de conteúdo
  • Mente aberta e conforto para criar conteúdos sobre namoro e relacionamentos


Estrutura de pagamento
  • Estrutura por níveis com pagamento semanal
  • Bônus por visualizações (a partir de 100 mil views)
  • Bônus por registros
  • Pagamentos realizados semanalmente
Por que se juntar a nós
  • Seja pago para criar conteúdo autêntico sobre namoro e autoexpressão
  • Acesso a orientação criativa, briefings e uma rede global de criadores
  • Construa seu portfólio enquanto colabora com a gente
  • Liberdade criativa — seu estilo, sua história, sua perspectiva

    • Como se candidatar

    Envie sua carta de apresentação e conte um pouco sobre você, incluindo por que gostaria de trabalhar com o app Pure.

    Você será convidado para uma call de onboarding em grupo e receberá uma tarefa para criar um vídeo de teste.

    Depois disso, você entrará em um período de teste de 2 semanas e, se for aprovado, será totalmente integrado ao programa.

    As candidaturas são analisadas de forma contínua.
